About the Role:

The Global Business Marketing team is seeking a Project Manager to join the Developer Marketing team.
This role sits at the center of product launches and ongoing go-to-market (GTM) execution — coordinating closely with agency vendors and internal teams, keeping deliverables on track, and ensuring every project moves smoothly from kickoff to completion.
The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and thrives on keeping many moving pieces aligned in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
To be successful in this role, this person will bring strong project management discipline, clear communication, and a proactive, follow-through mindset.
They will be the connective tissue between the team and its partners — anticipating needs, flagging risks early, and making sure work lands on time and to a high standard. A passion for organization, process, and partnership is essential.

Job Title:
Program Manager V
Minimum Qualifications:

5-8 years of project or program management experience.
Experience coordinating with and managing external agency vendors.
Experience managing multiple concurrent launches with competing deadlines and reprioritizing in real time.
Strong track record of building workback schedules and trackers and managing project timelines.
Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools (e.g., task management systems, case management systems.
Strong meeting facilitation and written status-reporting skills.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail across concurrent projects.
Clear, proactive communicator who drives follow-through and accountability.
Experience working in a cross-functional environment with creative, marketing, and developer teams.
Comfortable operating with ambiguity and shifting priorities.

Preferred Qualifications:

Familiarity with developer or technical marketing content and the review nuances it requires.
Experience with budget tracking, Statements of Work (SOWs), and vendor/Purchase Order (PO) management.
Experience partnering with localization and international teams on multi-market launches.
Comfort using Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to streamline project management workflows and reporting.

Key Responsibilities:

Serve as the primary point of coordination with external agency vendors and internal teams, ensuring deliverables are completed on time and according to specifications.
Build and maintain workback schedules, project timelines, and trackers across multiple concurrent workstreams.
Document feedback across review rounds, route it to the appropriate partners, and drive follow-through through resolution.
Manage day-to-day project logistics, keeping projects moving through each stage of review and approval.
Monitor project status, proactively identify risks and blockers, and keep stakeholders aligned on deadlines and dependencies.
Maintain organized documentation and clear single sources of truth for all active projects.
Facilitate clear and timely communication between internal teams and agency partners.

Location:
 Remote [USA - ONLY]

Salary Range: 
The salary for this position is between $199,600 - $249,600 annually.  Factors which may affect pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
In the journey of life, your career should make a difference.

At Inizio Evoke, we come together—to do the best work, in the best possible place. We're all in. Because it's everyone's role to make health more human™.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Program Manager to run the operating rhythm of Operatev — Inizio Evoke's enterprise AI platform — from the inside out.

This is a high-visibility, cross-functional role responsible for keeping the program on schedule and its status transparent. You'll own the connective tissue: sequencing work across Product, Development, Change & Enablement, Support, Operations, Business Transformation, and Commercialization so that nothing blocks on an unowned handoff and everyone is working from the same picture of where things stand.

You will sit at the center of a program that is building and rolling out a platform to 1,200 people. That means competing priorities, real dependencies, and a delivery pace that doesn't slow down. You will bring strong program management fundamentals in a product development environment, thrive on clarity and structure, and know how to translate complex cross-functional realities into reporting that actually drives decisions.

This is a remote role reporting to the Program Lead.

What You'll Do:

Own Cross-Team Sequencing

Map dependencies across functions — what depends on what, in what order — and monitor progress against that sequence
Ensure handoffs are owned, surface unresolved blockers early, and drive items to closure or escalation
Maintain visibility into the implications of sequencing decisions for Product, Development, and all downstream functions

Run the Quarterly Planning Cycle

Gather functional inputs across all workstreams
Facilitate commitment-setting and document outcomes
Translate quarterly commitments into trackable milestones and hold functions accountable to them

Track Program Resourcing

Maintain visibility into where capacity is going against what's committed and manage the program's calendar to proactively address capacity challenges
Surface trends and anomalies to program leadership before they become problems
Oversee recruitment process, meeting with talent acquisition for updates and ensuring timely progress through stakeholder participation

Set and Hold Stage Gate Standards

Define the gates work passes through and what evidence clears each one
Keep functional cadences in sync without taking over internal functional processes (sprint practices, capability lifecycle, etc.)

Run Delivery Forums

Facilitate the weekly initiative update and risk review
Maintain the risk register and drive items to resolution or escalation
Track progress against quarterly commitments and hold the reporting cadence

Define Reporting Standards

Establish and maintain the data taxonomy that governs how each function reports its metrics
Ensure functional outputs roll into one consistent program-level picture rather than competing narratives

Own Executive Reporting

Prepare and deliver the synthesized program view for executive and steering committee audiences
Surface where delivery reality constrains what's being asked — clearly and with context

What You'll Bring:

7+ years of experience in program management, delivery management, or PMO leadership — ideally within a technology platform, transformation, or product delivery context
Experience running formal planning cycles (quarterly or release-based) and translating outputs into trackable commitments
Track record of building and maintaining executive-level reporting that is trusted and acted on
Comfortable managing budget and resource visibility — not ownership, but accurate tracking and surfacing of variance
Background in professional services, agency, consulting, or regulated industry preferred (healthcare, life sciences, or similar)

Skills

Strong program and project management fundamentals — dependency mapping, risk management, stage gates, and cadence management
Highly organized: you make things visible, structured, and easy to act on
Strong written and verbal communication; able to translate complexity into clean reporting without losing accuracy
Comfortable operating in agile/iterative environments where priorities shift and the plan evolves
Skilled facilitator — able to run productive cross-functional forums without letting them drift

Mindset

You keep things moving without needing to own everything
You surface problems early and bring them forward with enough context for a decision
You enforce standards consistently — not rigidly, but reliably
You understand the difference between tracking and deciding, and you stay in your lane while making it easy for others to stay in theirs

What We Offer

A central, high-impact role in a program building something genuinely new — an enterprise AI platform designed to change how a 1,200-person agency does its work
Direct visibility to executive and steering committee leadership
A cross-functional operating environment where your work touches every part of the program
The opportunity to define and own the operating standards that the program runs on

Inizio Evoke provides an exciting and flexible work environment, great compensation packages and outstanding company paid benefits including medical, dental, 401(k), tuition reimbursement and flexible time off.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. This range may differ based on your experience and skill set, geographic location, and cost of living considerations. We consider compensation more than just a base salary – that’s why we also offer an exceptional range of flexible benefits, personal support and tailored learning and development opportunities all designed to help you realize your full potential both in life and at work.

$140,000—$170,000 USD

jobs.description:
Job Description

This is a hybrid role with a mix of remote and in-office working as part of Fidelity’s dynamic working arrangement.

Current work authorization for Canada is required for all openings.

Who We Are

Fidelity Investments is a world leader in mutual funds and ETF management. We pride ourselves in proprietary and disciplined research-driven investing. We offer a complete line of products and services to investors through a network of third-party brokers and financial advisors. Our primary goal is to support investment professionals as they endeavor to prepare their clients’ retirement and other significant life goals which demand focused financial management.

The role

The Project Manager (PM) is responsible to lead teams within a complex matrix environment to the successful completion of projects in support of multiple business lines, cross-functional in impact and are typically technical in nature. Depending on the type of project, it may follow the waterfall or agile methodology.

The PM is also accountable for the project team’s effectiveness by enabling the Agile methodologies to improve its practices within its frameworks.

How You’ll Make an Impact
Prepares project charter and develop detailed project plans including detailed scope statements, schedule and budget estimates and baselines, resource plans, quality plans and success criteria.
Completes all required project governance gates approval forms and presentations.
Establishes project communications and monitoring and control mechanisms.
Manages day to day project activities ensuring deliverables are met, risks are identified and assessed, and issues are managed and resolved.
Leads project team(s) in a matrix environment, clarifying roles & responsibilities, providing individual direction and feedback, and ensuring required communication support is in place.
Partners with the Project Management Office to ensure portfolio, program and project management standards, processes and procedures are adhered to.
Implements and utilizes reporting and control mechanisms, and in particular project change management approaches, to ensure the project’s triple constraints (time, cost, performance scope and quality) are well managed and status and issues are reported to sponsors, executive sponsors and senior management on a timely basis.
Ensures project post implementation reviews are planned and executed in compliance with Fidelity standards.
Works with vendors, industry firms and internal Fidelity business units to explore innovative business solutions with new technologies and alternative processes.
Participates in the preparation of RFPs, evaluate proposals, statements of work and select vendors.
In conjunction with internal partners, participate in meetings and act as the central point of contact to manage tasks, relationships, and deliverables during the lifecycle of the project.
Clear and concise Product goal definition and backlog items that the Project Team can easily understand and act upon.
Address impediments related to unclear backlog items or changing scope.
Facilitate stakeholder collaboration across business and technology teams.
Periodic advisory and coaching of the organization on Agile methodologies.
Continuous improvement reviews of the organization’s effectiveness at adopting Agile methodologies.
Ongoing support and the removal of barriers between stakeholders and Project Teams.
Periodic reporting of Project Team performance through well-defined Key Performance Indicators (e.g. burn-down / burn-up charts, velocity, etc.), value generation, and taking into consideration feedback from the Project Team, Business Owner, and key stakeholders.

University Degree or equivalent work experience or equivalent experience.
Certified Scrum Master or Professional Scrum Master certification.
Project Management Professional certification.

Minimum 3 years of experience working in a Project/Program Management and/ Scrum Master capacity.
Extensive experience in leading business and systems delivery teams using Project Management and Agile methodologies.
In-depth knowledge of Project Management and Agile frameworks, principles, and processes
Strong coaching and leadership skills.
Team focused with ability to teach teams how to be self-organized.
Adaptable to change and comfortable with transparency, inspection, and adaption.
Comfortable working with multiple teams.
Ability to build strong interpersonal relationships with cross divisional teams, senior management, and internal and external stakeholders.
Ability to work with cross divisional teams, senior management, and internal and external stakeholders.

jobs.title: AI GTM Program Manager
jobs.description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization
.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire
customer journey.

We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi
— so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

Bloomreach
builds agentic AI systems for our customers. We also run them ourselves.

Our AI SDR program books sales meetings with AI - inbound and outbound, across four regions, in multiple languages. The program needs an owner: someone who sets its direction, drives its results, and proves its ROI. This is a program leadership role, not an engineering one. Two dedicated AI ops experts build and run the platform. You decide what it does, why, and for whom. You should understand AI agents well enough to direct the people building them - your leverage is judgment, but being tech savvy is a must.

The team experiments by default: we test new AI tools, run scoped POCs, and keep what works. You'll own the program, its direction, its results, its pipeline number.

What You'll Own

The AI SDR program, end to end. Inbound and outbound, AMER + EMEA + APAC. Who gets enrolled, what the agents say, when a human takes over, and what it produces in pipeline. You set direction; the platform ops managers make it run. (Inbound request ops and routing sit with a colleague.)
Pipeline as your number, ROI as your story. Meetings booked → accepted → qualified pipeline created. Cost per meeting, cost per pipeline dollar. You report the program's return to leadership, with numbers that hold up under questioning.
The human SDR side. SDRs are the other half of the program - and where it most often breaks: lead quality disputes, unclear prioritization, follow-up that dies after one touch, handovers that lose context. You'll sit with the SDR teams and their leaders, find root causes, and fix them - with an AI assist, a process change, or a better definition.
The human–agent split. What agents do, what humans do, and where the handover sits. You own that line and move it based on evidence.
Signal-driven enrollment. Targeting runs on manual batches today. You'll drive the move to continuous enrollment based on account scoring, intent signals, and engagement decay. You define the logic; the ops team builds it.
The buying experience. Outreach should arrive because an account signalled something, say something true about the buyer's business, and make the next step obvious.
Program reporting. Volume, coverage, results, and ROI on a live dashboard, generated automatically. Parts still run on exports. Fix that early.
What comes next. The AI SDR pattern - signal in, agent acts, human closes - applies beyond outbound: event follow-up, hand-raiser nurture, re-engagement. Once the core program runs well, you'll make the case for the next one and drive its launch.

What success looks like after 3 months

Outbound volume and coverage are consistent across regions. Nobody asks "why did outbound drop last week?"
Leadership references your ROI model in planning: cost per meeting, cost per pipeline dollar, trend.
The top three SDR pain points from your first quarter are root-caused and fixed - and SDR leaders would confirm it unprompted.
Meeting acceptance is high. Rejections have known causes, not theories.
Reporting is fully automated. Your time goes into decisions.
The program activities and volume is connected to human activities, pipeline number for ICP accounts is bigger - and you can show which changes drove it.
At least one new agentic program is live and producing pipeline.

What you'll bring

You've run programs with a number attached. Demand gen, SDR/BDR, growth, or GTM programs where you owned the outcome and defended the metric.
You've operated AI workflows in production. You've deployed, directed, or owned automations other people depended on. You can set requirements, challenge the build, and tell when the agent is the problem versus the data. You don't need to write code - you do need to never be bluffed by it.
ROI fluency. You can build a cost-per-outcome model and explain it. You'd rather show a live dashboard than a slide.
You diagnose team problems at the source. "The leads are bad" is where your investigation starts, not where it ends. You've worked with frontline teams, found the real constraint, and fixed it.
SDRs, AEs, and their leaders are your users. When the program misfires, you’ll be their point of contact.
The buyer's point of view. Buyers don't care that outreach was efficient - only that it was worth their time. You'll kill a volume that doesn't clear that bar.
Enough technical depth to be dangerous. You can read a workflow, question a data model, and learn a new tool in a week. Experience with our stack is welcome, not required.
Global comfort. Four regions, several languages, overlap with US hours.

Big Advantage:: hands-on LLM tooling beyond vendor UIs (Claude Code, MCP, custom agents); time in or working with SDR/BDR and demand gen function in B2B SaaS.

The stack you'll drive

Salesforce

Qualified
Salesloft
UserGems
Claude - plus a mandate to evaluate AI-native tooling with a clear bar for measurable impact.

The team

You'll join Marketing Operations six people who operationalize and automate everything in marketing. Two of them work full-time on the AI SDR platform: they build and run it; you set its direction and co-own it: reporting and attribution, co-own and maintain inbound/outbound processes and find new tools. It's a team that builds its own tools rather than filing tickets for them.

More things you'll like about Bloomreach:

Culture:

A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one.
We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.
We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.
We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.
We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.
We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*.
The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5

Personal Development:

We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions.
Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.*
Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins.
Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)*

Well-being:

The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.*
Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.*
We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones.
We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other.
Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.*

Compensation:

Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.*
Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.*
We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000!
We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!*

(*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.)

Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences!

If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful!

jobs.description:
Imagine a piloted air taxi that takes off vertically, then quietly carries you and your fellow passengers over the congested city streets below, enabling you to spend more time with the people and places that matter most. At Joby, we've been working to make that dream a reality since 2009 and we're now in the final stages of certifying our aircraft with the FAA. With plans to launch our aircraft in the US and Dubai, we're now scaling manufacturing and preparing for the launch of our commercial service.

Overview

Joby’s Battery System serves as the core of our electric aircraft, encompassing the battery packs, the safety-critical Battery Management System (BMS) software, and the high-performance Ground Charging Equipment designed for rapid turnaround. This integrated ecosystem is meticulously engineered to support the demands of commercial eVTOL operations.

As a member of the technical program management team, you will lead the Battery System software domain, overseeing embedded C++ development for the BMS and Ground Charging System, along with model-based control algorithms. You will be responsible for facilitating design and driving execution through Scrum methodologies, managing DO-178C certification activities, and steering software through the release process for flight. In close partnership with the hardware and electrical PMs, you will manage the comprehensive Battery System technical roadmap, ensuring alignment on timelines, dependencies, and delivery milestones.

The position will be based at our San Carlos location with occasional travel to Marina and Santa Cruz sites as needed.

Responsibilities

Single point of accountability for Battery System software program execution across two development methodologies — embedded C++ and model-based design — on independent sprint cadences
Facilitate design without doing the design: translating architecture discussions into well-scoped workstreams, making dependencies and critical paths explicit, and driving risks and recovery plans to closure
Run scrum for the BMS flight software and Ground Charging software teams — sprint planning, execution, and summaries — across their independent cadences
Facilitate the model-based design lifecycle: requirements flow-down, sprint execution, characterization testing, and formal hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) verification, including rig scheduling, requirement coverage traceability, and failure disposition
Own the MBD-to-C++ release chain from development complete through characterization testing, HIL verification, documentation, and release evidence
Program-manage the DO-178C certification effort with our certification partner, software verification team, and FAA software designee, including high-level/low-level requirement traceability
Maintain an integrated program schedule, and partner with the Battery System hardware/electrical program manager on the overall Battery System roadmap, timeline, and cross-team dependencies
Coordinate on-time delivery into system-level integration and test environments for integrated testing and aircraft safe-for-flight release, including powertrain plant models for HIL verification
Coordinate flight software release with the broader Joby software organization, and Ground Charging software integration with fleet infrastructure and fielded equipment
Run the program's operating cadence: program reviews, key metrics (technical, schedule, risk), and concise status reporting to leadership
Identify, advocate for, and manage the development of test assets for software prototyping and verification

Required

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 5+ years of relevant experience
5+ years of technical program management for embedded software or integrated hardware/software development, managing requirements, priorities, scope, and schedule
Experience performing the Scrum master role for embedded or firmware teams, including managing multiple workstreams on different sprint cadences
Experience delivering software under a formal safety-critical process (DO-178C preferred; ISO 26262 / ASIL D functional safety is a strong equivalent)
Deep familiarity with the embedded software development lifecycle (C++, real-time targets), with the ability to make engineering-informed program decisions
Strong track record of managing complex cross-functional programs and dependencies across teams you don't directly control
Experience with Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar tools, as well as requirements management tools (e.g., Jama, DOORS, Polarion)
Clear, well-structured, and concise communication tailored to each audience, from engineers to executives
Ability to manage a cross-functional team, including interfaces with hardware design and test teams, through an iterative design process

Desired

Familiarity with DO-178C program execution, including DO-331 (model-based development) and DO-330 (tool qualification)
Familiarity with model-based design workflows (MATLAB/Simulink) and the model-to-code handoff
Familiarity with HIL test platforms (e.g., dSPACE, NI, Speedgoat)
Familiarity with battery systems, BMS, high voltage systems, or EV charging / EVSE
Familiarity with FAA or EASA certification programs (ARP4754A)
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
Experience thriving in a fast-paced, quick-iteration hardware environment

jobs.description:

Are you excited by the opportunity to drive programs that put robots into the real world, coordinating across software, research, and hardware teams to ship systems that move, plan, and adapt at fleet scale? Are you energized by the challenge of turning leading research into production-ready capabilities?

At Amazon Robotics, we're building the future of mobile robotic systems. Our robots don't just follow lines on a floor. They navigate dynamic environments, coordinate with each other, and make decisions in real time. Technical Program Managers here don't sit on the sidelines. You'll be in the middle of it, connecting applied scientists, research scientists, software engineers, and program teams to deliver things that haven't been done before.

The problems we solve are hard. Requirements shift as research matures. Timelines compress as business needs grow. There's ambiguity everywhere, and that's the point. We're looking for someone who sees that ambiguity as the job, not as an obstacle to it. Someone who can build structure without slowing teams down, and drive alignment without waiting for permission.

Come build what's next in robotics.

Work cross functionally with other TPMs, program teams, SW teams, applied scientists, and research to align on priorities, dependencies, and delivery timelines

Identify risks and dependencies early, escalate with data, and drive resolution

jobs.description:
Description

Shape the future of secure communications for the world's most critical missions. As a Principal Technical Program Manager for SCS TEMEG, you'll define the strategy and lead customers and cross-functional teams to solve problems of high ambiguity and high impact.

Secure Connections Services (SCS), Tactical Edge Mission Engineering Group (TEMEG) designs, develops, and delivers emerging edge capabilities to enable the use of AWS services.

You own the strategic roadmap and drive cross-organizational alignment on priorities and delivery. You leverage deep technical expertise and executive-level stakeholder management to deliver solutions from concept through customer adoption. You bring proven experience architecting large-scale distributed systems and apply that expertise to commercial and government customers. You are data- and metric-driven, and relentlessly focused on performance in resource-constrained environments.

Solve challenging problems that will revolutionize satellite connectivity in the cloud
Work for a recognized leader in supporting space customers with cloud computing
Have direct impact on hundreds, possibly thousands, of users of the AWS secure connections ecosystem.

If you're driven to lead at the intersection of security innovation and mission-critical impact, this is the role for you.

If Arlington, VA (Arlington HQ2)

This role will sit in our new headquarters in Northern Virginia, where Amazon will invest $2.5 billion dollars, occupy 4 million square feet of energy efficient office space, and create at least 25,000 new full-time jobs. Our employees and the neighboring community will also benefit from the associated investments from the Commonwealth including infrastructure updates, public transportation improvements, and new access to Reagan National Airport.

By working together on behalf of our customers, we are building the future one innovative product, service, and idea at a time. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This position requires that the candidate selected must be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities

In This Role You Will

Serve as the primary executive interface with customers, translating mission-critical requirements into product roadmap priorities for engineering teams
Drive cross-organizational alignment across product, engineering, sales, and partner teams to deliver integrated solutions
Work across the product, program, engineering, hardware, software, and infrastructure teams to manage requirements, scope, and delivery of worldwide AWS security features and services
Assess risks, anticipate issues, overcome technical obstacles, and make difficult trade-off decisions while managing cost and schedule to drive adoption goals and meet our customer commitments.

Successful candidates will have a strong technical background, be detail oriented, and have excellent problem-solving abilities. You will represent program status to senior leadership. Your program management expertise and operational excellence will influence teams’ decisions and drive secure and scalable solutions. You should be passionate about delivering great customer experiences and changing the way customers leverage AWS services.

Builders at Amazon work on real world problems on a global scale, own their systems end-to-end, and influence the direction of our technology that impacts hundreds of millions customers around the world. Join a team of super smart, customer obsessed builders that think big and have fun.

A day in the life

In this role, you will own the planning and execution of a new service managing cross-team and cross-org development and delivery, participating in architecture decisions, design reviews, and represent our service to Senior and Executive leadership. You will work with software developers and networking engineers along with product managers and other oranizations to deliver new services and new features create the best in class solutions for our customers worldwide!

Candidates must be comfortable with ambiguity and eager to embrace ownership and accountability.

About AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Why AWS?

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
5+ years of software development experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
7+ years of professional or military experience
Current, active US Government Security Clearance of Top Secret with SCI eligibility or above

Preferred Qualifications

12+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
Experience in security of web services, video content protection technologies, cryptography, network security protocols and operating system security
Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
Experience with network, system, or software architecture
Experience communicating technical details verbally and in writing
Experience influencing innovation through a partner ecosystem with either solutions or programs that have demonstrated success at enterprise customers
Current, active US Government Security Clearance of TS/SCI with Polygraph

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager - Fitness/Gym
jobs.description:
A growing fitness and wellness organization is seeking a highly adaptable Business Operations Manager to play a key role in supporting the next stage of its growth. This is an opportunity to step into a newly created position with broad visibility across a multi-location business and help build the systems, structure, and operational discipline needed to scale successfully. Working closely with senior leadership and gym operations teams, you will become a central resource across the organization, helping connect people, systems, reporting, administration, and day-to-day execution.

The role is intentionally broad. You may be reviewing KPIs and identifying operational gaps one day, supporting payroll or systems administration the next, then helping prepare a new location for opening. The common thread is ownership. You will be trusted to understand how the business works, identify what needs attention, and help create practical solutions that make the organization stronger and more efficient. This role will appeal to someone who enjoys variety, thrives in an entrepreneurial environment, and sees opportunity in building better ways of working. As the organization continues to expand, you will have the chance to shape the role, influence how the business operates, and become an important part of the infrastructure supporting its future growth.

Description

Manage and support key administrative and operational systems across multiple corporate gym locations.
Take ownership of responsibilities currently managed by senior leadership, helping create scalable processes as the organization grows.
Monitor, maintain, and audit business systems to ensure information is accurate, current, and being used consistently.
Review operational reporting and KPIs, identifying discrepancies, trends, and areas requiring follow-up.
Work closely with Gym Managers, General Managers, Assistant General Managers, and senior operations leadership.
Review membership billing issues and help ensure errors or discrepancies are identified and resolved.
Monitor cash deposits and financial transactions to ensure appropriate reporting and accountability.
Support payment administration for employees, contractors, personal trainers, vendors, and other business partners.
Ensure employee information and new hires are properly entered and maintained within HR and payroll systems.
Provide administrative support related to HR, payroll, onboarding, and employee records.
Assist with system access, password resets, troubleshooting, and day-to-day technology-related issues.
Support the administration of security, IT, email, and other business platforms used across the organization.
Assist with website updates and other corporate administrative projects as required.
Support new gym openings, including systems setup, administration, onboarding, and operational readiness.
Travel between corporate locations when required to support operations, projects, or new openings.
Identify opportunities to improve processes, simplify workflows, and create greater consistency across locations.
Take on additional operational and administrative responsibilities as the needs of the business continue to evolve.

Requirements

Strong experience in business administration, operations, systems administration, office management, or a similar multi-functional role.
Highly computer literate with the ability to quickly learn and work across multiple software platforms.
Strong systems mindset with excellent attention to detail and an ability to identify errors or inconsistencies.
Comfortable working with reports, KPIs, billing information, payroll-related administration, and basic financial controls.
Strong problem-solving skills and the confidence to investigate issues and determine practical solutions.

to support Sales Operations and business performance management across Latin America and Mexico. Job Responsibilities

Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Information Systems, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field.

Advanced Power BI development experience is mandatory, including creating dashboards, reports, data models, calculations, and visualizations from business requirements.

Global Future Leaders Program: Start Strong. Lead Early.

The Lenovo Global Future Leaders Program is a highly selective program designed to develop Lenovo's next generation of business and technology leaders. Created for exceptional graduates, the program provides accelerated development opportunities for individuals ready to grow their careers and make an impact at one of the world's leading technology companies.

As a Global Future Leader, you'll gain hands-on experience through challenging assignments and rotational opportunities across Lenovo. You'll collaborate with teams and leaders around the world, building a broad understanding of our organization while developing the skills needed to create meaningful impact. During your first three years, you'll participate in cross-functional experiences, strategic projects, leadership development, and mentorship opportunities designed to accelerate your growth. From day one, you'll take on meaningful work, gain exposure to senior leaders, and help drive innovative solutions that deliver smarter technology for all. We're looking for ambitious problem-solvers, innovative thinkers, and future leaders who are energized by technology, embrace new challenges, and are eager to make an impact.

What You Can Expect

Cross-functional rotational experiences across Lenovo's business, providing broad exposure and diverse career experiences
Meaningful business impact from day one through strategic projects and real-world challenges
Exposure to senior leaders along with structured leadership development and mentorship
Collaboration with global teams and stakeholders across one of the world's leading technology companies
Accelerated career growth through innovation, continuous learning, and opportunities to influence the future of smarter technology for all

In This Global Future Leader role, you will act as a Strategy Analyst

Role Overview

In this role, you will support the development and execution of Motorola’s overall business strategy as well as focused strategic initiatives across areas such as regional expansion, cost savings, investment optimization, and business growth. You will analyze market and business trends, translate data into actionable insights, and coordinate strategic initiatives across cross-functional and regional teams. This role is designed for an early-career professional who is analytical, detail-oriented, and organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and build effective partnerships across a global organization.

What You’ll Do

Strategic Initiative Support: Contribute to strategic initiatives across Motorola’s key business priorities and geographies by coordinating inputs, tracking progress, and preparing analyses.
Market Business Analysis: Analyze market trends, business performance, consumer insights, and changes in the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and inform strategic recommendations.
Competitive Market Intelligence: Develop competitive analyses, market intelligence summaries, and clear, data-supported insights for business and marketing stakeholders.
Investment Spend Optimization: Support efforts to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of Motorola’s investments and business spend.
Executive Reporting Communication: Create clear presentations, reports, and communication materials for the global business, strategy organization, and leadership audiences.

Cross-Functional Strategy Execution: Collaborate with cross-functional teams and regional partners to support alignment and execution of Motorola’s strategic business priorities.

What You’ll Learn

How global business strategies are developed, evaluated, and executed across Motorola’s strategic priorities and geographic markets.
How to analyze market trends, business performance, consumer insights, and competitive intelligence to identify opportunities and inform strategic decisions.
How to translate complex business and market data into clear, actionable recommendations for business and leadership stakeholders.
How to develop business cases, define assumptions, establish KPIs, and evaluate the potential impact of new strategic initiatives.
How global strategy, marketing, regional, and cross-functional teams collaborate to execute business priorities within the technology and consumer electronics industry.

jobs.description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization
.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire
customer journey.

We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi
— so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Security Analyst to join the Bloomreach GIST (Global Information Security & Technology) team to help protect our environment from threats, vulnerabilities, and sophisticated attackers. Your work will have a significant impact on numerous customers across various e-commerce verticals and hundreds of millions of online users. As a core member of our globally distributed 24/7 Security Operations Team, you are expected to work from one of our India offices ( Bengaluru) or from home. This role is ideal for someone who has built a solid foundation in security operations and is ready to take the next step — owning more complex work, developing specialised skills, and contributing more meaningfully to the team's detection and response mission

Your job will include, but is not limited to:

Monitor, analyze, and interpret security, system, application, cloud, and infrastructure logs to identify suspicious activity, configuration irregularities, and potential security incidents.
Leverage security tools, custom-built dashboards, threat intelligence, and proactive investigation techniques to detect anomalous or malicious activity.
Monitor cloud infrastructure and services for security-related events, misconfigurations, and indicators of compromise.
Monitor the evolving threat and vulnerability landscape, including security advisories, emerging threats, and relevant vulnerabilities, and coordinate or escalate findings as appropriate.
Investigate security alerts, incidents, and service requests, performing appropriate triage, analysis, documentation, escalation, and follow-up.
Develop, maintain, tune, and improve security detection use cases and alerts within SIEM and other security monitoring platforms.
Design, implement, and maintain automation workflows using SOAR or similar security orchestration and automation technologies.
Collaborate with Product Security, Infrastructure Security, Application Security, GRC, Engineering, and other relevant teams during cross-functional security investigations.
Work with GRC, Privacy, Legal, Product, and technical teams during security or privacy-related incidents and investigations, providing technical findings and evidence where required.
Participate in major incident calls and support incident response activities, including investigation, evidence gathering, timeline development, and preparation of incident summaries.
Document, follow, and execute Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), security playbooks, investigation procedures, and escalation processes.
Create, manage, maintain, and continuously improve security use cases, playbooks, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles.
Support audit-related activities by gathering security evidence, validating controls, and collaborating with relevant stakeholders as required.
Maintain a working knowledge of AI and Large Language Model (LLM) tools such as Gemini, ChatGPT, and Claude, and understand their practical application within Security Operations.
Understand common authentication and credential-management concepts, including public/private key authentication, API keys, access tokens, service accounts, and the secure handling of credentials.
Be comfortable working with command-line interfaces (CLI), APIs, IDE-based tools, and agent-based workflows commonly used in modern security and cloud environments.
Take ownership of responsibilities assigned during the shift, ensuring effective handovers, timely escalation, and appropriate follow-through.
Proactively engage relevant stakeholders and escalate risks, incidents, blockers, or concerns when necessary.
Maintain a positive approach toward continuous learning, professional development, and upskilling as security technologies, threats, and operational practices evolve.

Required Experience

Professional experience, skills & requirements

3–5 years of hands-on experience working within a 24×7 Security Operations Center (SOC), Cyber Fusion Center, or equivalent security operations function.
Hands-on experience in at least one or more of the following areas:
SaaS platform security
Cloud security, particularly AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
API and container security
Threat intelligence and threat hunting
Vulnerability management
SIEM or SOAR administration, engineering, or operational use

Strong hands-on experience using SIEM platforms for security monitoring, investigation, correlation, and detection engineering. Experience with Splunk is preferred.
Practical experience with SOAR platforms and security automation workflows.
Hands-on experience with Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) and related capabilities such as threat intelligence, vulnerability/exposure management, device control, or data protection.
Hands-on experience with CSPM/CNAPP platforms such as Wiz, CrowdStrike Falcon Cloud Security, Prisma Cloud, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Sysdig, or equivalent.
Hands-on experience assessing, interpreting, prioritizing, and managing vulnerabilities using platforms such as CrowdStrike Exposure Management/Spotlight, Qualys, Rapid7, Wiz, or equivalent.
Practical working experience with AWS or GCP is mandatory, including an understanding of cloud identity, logging, networking, compute, storage, and security controls.
Basic scripting skills using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or equivalent for security operations, investigation, or automation use cases.

Incident Response & Coordination

Demonstrated experience investigating and coordinating security incidents across technical and non-technical teams.
Ability to act as an Incident Commander / Incident Coordinator for security incidents, driving the response from initial triage through containment, remediation, recovery, and closure.
Ability to establish clear ownership of investigation workstreams, actions, dependencies, and follow-up activities during an incident.
Ability to make operational decisions during an incident, prioritize investigation activities, and escalate matters requiring specialist technical, legal, privacy, compliance, or management authority.
Ability to maintain accurate incident timelines and ensure key findings, decisions, actions, risks, and outstanding items are appropriately documented.
Ability to provide clear and timely incident status updates to relevant stakeholders and Security leadership.
Experience supporting or leading post-incident reviews, lessons-learned exercises, and follow-up remediation tracking.

Security Knowledge

Good understanding of the cybersecurity incident lifecycle, including identification, triage, investigation, containment, remediation, recovery, and post-incident activities.
Working knowledge of security frameworks and methodologies
Understanding of cybersecurity risk concepts and the ability to assess the potential technical and business impact of identified security issues.
Ability to monitor and assess emerging cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and industry developments and determine their relevance to the organization.
Strong understanding of security monitoring and investigation concepts, including the ability to correlate information across multiple security and infrastructure data sources.
Understanding of authentication and credential-management concepts, including public/private key authentication, API keys, access tokens, service accounts, and secure credential handling.

Analytical & Operational Skills

Ability to independently investigate and manage security events of moderate complexity, while appropriately escalating higher-risk, complex, or unfamiliar situations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to apply logical reasoning during investigations and decision-making.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to connect findings across logs, cloud platforms, endpoints, threat intelligence, identity systems, applications, and other relevant sources.
Willingness to participate in and take ownership of Proofs of Concept (PoCs), security-tool evaluations, process improvements, and operational initiatives.
Proactive approach to improving detections, automation, monitoring coverage, playbooks, documentation, and team knowledge.
Ability to work with command-line interfaces, APIs, IDE-based tools, and modern security or cloud engineering workflows.
Working knowledge of AI/LLM tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or equivalent, including their practical and secure application within Security Operations.

Communication & Collaboration

Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate investigation findings, risks, status, and required actions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to communicate confidently and effectively during active security incidents and major incident calls.
Experience working within globally distributed teams and collaborating effectively across cultures, regions, functions, and time zones.
Collaborative and team-oriented approach, with the ability to work effectively with Security, Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, GRC, Privacy, Legal, and other business stakeholders.
Ability to engage relevant stakeholders and escalate incidents, risks, blockers, or concerns in a timely and appropriate manner.
Ability to provide concise and accurate shift handovers, operational updates, and incident summaries.

Shift Requirements

Willingness and ability to work in a 24×7 monthly rotating shift schedule, including weekends.
The position follows a five-day work week, with shift timings and weekly days off determined according to the applicable rotation schedule.
Ability to independently own responsibilities assigned during a shift and ensure effective handover and follow-through.
Willingness to take ownership during active security incidents occurring within the assigned shift and coordinate the response until an appropriate handover or closure.

Preferred Qualifications

Entry-level or intermediate cybersecurity certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, GIAC GSEC, cloud security certifications, or equivalent industry-recognized certifications.
Previous experience working within a SaaS, e-commerce, cloud-native, or technology company.
Experience supporting security operations in environments involving large-scale cloud infrastructure, APIs, containers, distributed applications, or SaaS platforms.
Previous experience acting as an Incident Coordinator, Incident Commander, or security incident lead is highly desirable.

Your success story will be:

In the first 30 days you will

Understand the roles & responsibilities of SOC team, in-scope vs out of scope tasks
Read & understand SOPs, Policies & working procedures of the team
Shadow peers in day to day work, overlook tickets, alerts, incidents, understand the current state of ongoing projects/enhancements etc

jobs.description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

Job Overview:

Legal and Compliance manages all legal and regulatory matters, including privacy, contracts, corporate governance, compliance, employment law, intellectual property, government relations, and claims, while supporting Coursera's and Udemy's platforms and partnerships. The Privacy Program Manager is responsible for operationalizing and scaling the company's global privacy program across products, platforms, and business functions. Working closely with Legal, Security, Engineering, Product, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners, this role translates privacy and data protection requirements into scalable operational processes, governance, and technical controls that embed privacy by design across the organization. The role owns core privacy operations, including privacy impact assessments, records of processing activities, vendor privacy reviews, and data subject rights requests, while driving automation, self-service capabilities, and continuous improvement to enable the business to meet privacy obligations efficiently at scale.

Responsibilities:

Lead and continuously improve core privacy program operations, including privacy impact assessments (DPIAs), records of processing activities (ROPAs), vendor privacy reviews, and privacy compliance workflows, using privacy management tools and workflow automation where appropriate.
Design, implement, and manage scalable processes for data subject rights requests and general privacy inquiries, partnering with Engineering and Support teams to improve efficiency while meeting regulatory deadlines.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Marketing, Procurement, and other stakeholders to conduct privacy reviews for new products, features, vendors, and business initiatives, embedding privacy by design into business processes.
Develop and maintain privacy policies, standards, operational guidance, training, records, and self-service resources that enable teams to manage routine privacy obligations independently, with clear escalation paths where appropriate.
Monitor changes in global privacy laws and regulations, translating legal requirements into practical operational processes, controls, and guidance.
Define and report on privacy program metrics, identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, and support initiatives related to incident response, data retention, cross-border data transfers, and broader privacy governance.

Qualifications:

5+ years of experience in privacy, data protection, compliance, or a related program management function.
Demonstrated experience supporting a privacy program subject to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and one or more U.S. state privacy laws, such as the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), within a multinational or complex organization.
Demonstrated experience translating privacy and data protection requirements, including GDPR and CCPA, into operational processes, policies, controls, guidance, or technical requirements in partnership with Legal, Engineering, Product, and Security teams.
Experience conducting operational privacy activities, including DPIAs, maintaining ROPAs, managing data subject rights requests, vendor privacy reviews, privacy due diligence, and privacy contract reviews.
Experience implementing, administering, or optimizing a privacy management platform (such as OneTrust, TrustArc, or a comparable solution) to support privacy operations, workflow automation, and program governance.
Bachelor's degree (or equivalent practical experience) and a Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP), Certified Information Privacy Manager (CIPM), Certified Information Privacy Technologist (CIPT), or equivalent privacy certification.

Nice to haves:

Experience working in a technology, software-as-a-service (SaaS), or online education environment.
Experience supporting privacy programs for artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning products.
Experience supporting compliance with additional global privacy laws, including APAC and Latin American privacy frameworks.
Experience defining and reporting operational metrics, KPIs, or dashboards for privacy programs.
Law degree or equivalent legal training.

Coursera offers competitive pay and fair compensation practices across all regions. Job titles may span multiple career levels, and the targeted hiring base salary range for this role in Canada is CAD 78,400 to CAD 98,000. Actual compensation will depend on factors such as experience, education, transferable skills, business needs, and location. This range may be adjusted over time and may include eligibility for variable pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

Keep Learning

If this opportunity interests you, you might like these courses on Coursera:

Privacy Law and Data Protection

Data Privacy, Security, Governance, Risk, and Compliance

As a Managed Account Trading Operations Analyst, the individual will be responsible for monitoring workflow and ensuring daily team deadlines are achieved for trade execution, booking client allocations and completing voluntary corporate action elections for client accounts managed Investment Managers. Self-motivated, proactive and able work with minimal supervision

Series 7 license
Experience with Managed Products

Detailed Job Description

PetroChina Canada (PCC) is a wholly owned subsidiary of PetroChina Company Limited which is partially owned by China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC), a state-owned enterprise. CNPC is China's largest oil company and the world's third largest oil company, operating 91 energy-related projects in over 35 countries and regions. PCC has invested billions of dollars in an asset-rich portfolio of upstream, midstream and downstream operations. In Alberta, this includes our MacKay River and Dover oilsands projects, Duvernay Shale Gas and a 50% interest in the Grand Rapids Pipeline. In British Columbia, we hold joint venture interests in the Groundbirch tight gas project and LNG Canada.

PetroChina Canada is recruiting for a Master Data Analyst to join the Supply Chain Management (SCM) Team in Calgary.

Reporting to the Deputy Director SCM, the Master Data Analyst (MDA) will provide support to the Master Data team to ensure the integrity of Company’s Master Data initiatives. The MDA will be responsible for the creation, validation and maintenance of procurement Master Data inclusive of material masters, service masters, inventory and performance data. Another key responsibility will be analyzing and evaluating data for accuracy, as well as trouble shooting and resolving problems related to procurement master data.

The MDA position is a key component of Materials Management function to deliver standardized, accurate, consistent, robust data in a timely manner for the successful execution of Company operations.

This is a full-time in-office position. Some travel may be required to PCC’s Oils Sands and Shale Gas sites.

Accountabilities

The accountabilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

Master Data Management

Create and maintain centralized SAP material and service master data records for Company’s projects and operations
Validate all requests, identifying issues before creation/changes are made in the system
Provide key-user support for master data queries.
Meet customer service level demands in a timely manner with consideration to customers in various domestic and third-party locations
Ensure the highest level of data integrity by adhering to defined standards and guidelines, by continuous monitoring, measurement, sustainment and improvement of Material and Service Master quality
Maintain data integrity by performing periodic data cleansing activities in collaboration with various commercial and technical functional teams
Coordinate expansion of MM master data usage in Company’s areas of operation as SAP usage is expanded
Communicate with and train company staff from various disciplines on the creation and usage of master data

Elements Of Materials Management

This role is very closely associated with the Materials Management function of the Supply Chain organization. MDA shall work very closely with Site Warehouse Supervisor, Operations & Maintenance (O&M) Planner, O&M Scheduler and the Buyers to execute the following tasks efficiently:
Run MRP on daily basis as per the established schedule, validating and amending any MRP Run errors, if any
Confirm accuracy of MRP List against “Reservations”
Work closely with O&M Planners and Schedulers to ensure conversion of Planned Orders to Purchase Requisitions
Monitor and maintain MRP Attributes diligently.
Run Inventory Management reports and analyze the inventory data to identify potential overstocking/ stock outs in relation to the performance of master data MRP attributes.
Ensure that the Category Structure is proactively maintained and all master data management activities are completely aligned with it.
Ensure that assignment or de-assignment of MRP controls to any new / returned material is carried out in consultation with Warehouse Supervisor, Buyer and the business unit personnel.
Maintain proper backup documentation and approvals for such assignment / de-assignment of MRP attributes.

Qualifications

A degree in Business, Data Analytics, Supply Chain Management or other related field from a recognized institution
3-5 years experience in a Master Data role, with a minimum of three years’ related experience in the oil and gas industry
SAP experience in the Materials Management module required
Experience working with material and service master records and warehouse processes will be considered an asset
Solid skills in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and SAP
Superior oral and written skills to communicate with all levels internally and externally
Demonstrated high level of accuracy and keen attention to details
Strong analytical, critical thinking, negotiation and problem-solving skills
Strong project management skills
Strong organizational and time management skills
Ability to balance multiple competing priorities and to embrace ambiguity
Knowledge of systems used by supply management
Willingness to continuously learn about oilfield materials, equipment and services
Knowledge of the Oil & Gas industry as it relates to procurement, contracts, materials management and inventory principles and practices will be considered an asset
Knowledge of oilfield materials, equipment and services will be considered an asset
Adoption and demonstration of PetroChina Canada Values (Honorable, Unified, Passionate, Accountable)

ESRT seeks an equally passionate colleague to join the team, understand the vision and help achieve that vision.

Position Summary

The Sr. Project Manager will lead complex, high-profile capital improvement, tenant construction, specialty construction, visitor-experience, and building-compliance projects across assigned ESRT properties and projects. This position will oversee projects from initial planning, design, and procurement through construction, turnover, and financial closeout, often within occupied and operationally sensitive environments.

The Sr. Project Manager will partner closely with Property Management, Leasing, Design & Architecture, Engineering and Operations, IT/AV, Finance and Accounting, Legal and Risk, Security, Sustainability, Marketing, and other internal teams to develop project strategies, establish budgets and schedules, manage consultants and contractors, and ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with ESRT’s quality standards. This role will also provide project leadership, guidance, and mentorship to project management professionals and cross-functional project teams.

Responsibilities

PROJECT MANAGEMENT:

Lead multiple concurrent capital improvement (Capex) and tenant installation (TI) projects from initial scope development through design, bidding, construction, turnover, and financial closeout
Establish project objectives, scopes of work, budgets, schedules, procurement strategies, and execution plans in partnership with internal stakeholders
Manage projects that may include:
Lobby restorations and renovations
Storefront renovations and replacements
Corridor and restroom renovations
Façade, roof, window, and Local Law 11/FISP work
HVAC, electrical, plumbing, sprinkler, and other building-system improvements
Pre-built and build-to-suit spaces
Tenant-performed construction and alteration projects
Specialty exhibit, visitor-experience, media, AV/IT, fabrication, and other technically integrated projects

Direct all phases of design and construction, including programming, feasibility analysis, design development, budgeting, value engineering, scheduling, permitting, construction administration, commissioning, turnover, and closeout
Conduct regular site visits to monitor progress, workmanship, safety, logistics, and compliance with approved plans and project requirements
Develop and coordinate construction logistics for occupied and high-traffic environments, including tenant continuity, visitor impacts, noisy work, night work, freight, overtime, temporary protections, access, security requirements, and phased execution
Identify potential project risks, delays, cost impacts, operational conflicts, and required decisions; develop mitigation plans, maintain current risk and decision tracking, and escalate significant concerns with clear recommendations when appropriate

Financial & Contract Management

Support the development of annual and long-term capital plans by providing project budgets, forecasts, timing assumptions, risk assessments, and execution recommendations in partnership with Property Management, Leasing, Finance and Accounting, and other stakeholders
Maintain accurate project forecasts, cash-flow projections, commitments, change-order logs, and cost-to-complete reporting
Review proposals, bids, contracts, invoices, requisitions, and change orders for accuracy, completeness, and alignment with approved project scope and budget.
Lead procurement and contractor-selection strategies, including RFP and bid-package development, bidder shortlisting, proposal analysis, scope leveling, bidder interviews, CM/GC and GMP evaluation, award recommendations, contract administration, and compliance documentation
Monitor project financial performance and provide timely reporting on budgets, commitments, anticipated costs, variances, and cash flow

Come Near is a group of people moved to raise the public conversation about Jesus. They create, curate, and connect people to authentic Jesus stories and experiences. Most widely recognized is the group’s “He Gets Us” campaign, which invites people to reconsider Jesus and has reached millions of Americans since launching in 2021. To learn more, visit comenear.org.

Candidates for this role are required to sign the organization’s Statement of Faith, which closely aligns with Come Near’s mission-driven focus of inviting all people one step closer to the authentic Jesus from wherever they are.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Project Manager knows how great creative work gets made and what it takes to get it across the finish line.

This role sits at the intersection of creative, strategy, production, and operations. You’ll partner closely with our Executive Creative Directors and Strategy to shepherd ambitious projects from initial brief through creative development, production, and launch.

You won’t simply manage timelines. You’ll help teams figure out how to make the work happen, bringing the right people together, anticipating challenges, managing scope and budget, and creating the conditions for excellent creative work.

A strong understanding of creative production is essential. You should be comfortable reviewing production bids and estimates, understanding what’s driving costs, spotting gaps or unnecessary expenses, and asking smart questions of production partners.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead complex creative projects from brief through development, production, launch, and final delivery.
Partner closely with ECDs and Strategy to translate creative ambition into clear scopes, timelines, budgets, milestones, and production plans.
Create the structure teams need to do great work without introducing unnecessary process.
Anticipate risks, dependencies, and roadblocks and proactively bring solutions to the table.
Bring cross-functional teams into projects at the right moments, including Media, Social, Digital Product, Communications, Research, Legal, and other partners.
Manage project budgets and maintain visibility into scope changes and their implications for cost and timing.
Review and pressure-test production bids, estimates, and scopes of work across film, photography, design, digital, experiential, social/content, and post-production.
Understand the key drivers behind production costs—including staffing, shoot days, talent, usage, travel, post-production, markups, fees, and contingencies—and know when to ask questions.
Partner with the Studio Manager to anticipate resource needs, engage freelancers and external partners, and keep projects appropriately staffed.
Manage relationships with agencies, production companies, directors, photographers, vendors, and other external partners.
Ensure projects are delivered with excellence while balancing creative ambition, timelines, and responsible stewardship of resources.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

7+ years of experience in project management, integrated production, creative operations, or a similar role within an agency, brand, or creative studio.
Experience leading complex, integrated creative projects from inception through production and delivery.
Strong knowledge of creative and production workflows.
Experience reviewing production estimates, vendor bids, and scopes of work—and the confidence to challenge them when something doesn’t add up.
Strong financial and commercial judgment around production budgets.
Experience partnering directly with senior creative and strategic leaders.
The ability to bring clarity and momentum to complex projects without over-managing them.
Strong cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence teams you don’t directly manage.
Experience working with external agencies, production companies, vendors, and freelance talent.
Excellent communication, organization, prioritization, and problem-solving skills.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and figuring out the path forward as the work evolves.
A high bar for craft, collaboration, accountability, and execution.

PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

A personal relationship with Jesus and a passion for Come Near’s mission.
A heart for service, humility, and collaborative leadership.
You see project management as more than keeping a project on schedule. You understand the idea behind the work and help create the conditions for that idea to become as strong as it can be.
You can move comfortably between a conversation about creative ambition and a conversation about why a production estimate just increased.
You know when to push, when to protect the team, when to escalate, and when to simply clear the path.
Most importantly, you care deeply about making excellent work—and you know how to bring people, partners, budgets, and timelines together to make it happen.
