Annual performance bonus (based on organizational performance)
80% employer-paid health and wellness coverage
403(b) retirement plan with 7% employer match
Very generous PTO
Three annual company rest weeks (around July 4 and between Christmas and New Years)

Much more!

Who We Are

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

Our Culture

We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, Toronto, and São Paulo. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere
We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.
We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

Location:

Remote - United States or Canada
From Home / Beach / Mountain / Cafe / Anywhere!
We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed team. You can find your productive zone and work from there.

About The Role

As Sardine grows with enterprise clients, our delivery process needs to meet the program management rigor that clients expect — formal governance, clear ownership, and predictable reporting — while moving at the pace of a fast-growing startup, not a large legacy vendor.

You'll own the integration project plan on complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise engagements: milestone deliverables, dependencies, implementation timeline, and tracking client-specific product feature requests through to resolution, all built and maintained in close coordination with the client. You'll establish RACI and communication cadences, keep Engineering, Product, and the Solutions team pointed at the same critical path, and report honestly on what's slipping and why.

What You'll Be Doing

Own the integration project plan for enterprise engagements, including milestone deliverables, dependencies, and implementation timeline
Be the client’s trusted point of contact throughout the integration: Communicating regularly & proactively, surfacing risks early, and deeply understanding the client’s requirements
Track client-specific product feature requests from intake through resolution, so tickets filed with Engineering and Product don't get lost or stall without visibility
Establish RACI and roles/responsibilities upfront on every engagement, so accountability is unambiguous to both Sardine and the client's project office
Manage regular, structured communication across Engineering, Product, Integrations, and the client — and manage client expectations proactively rather than reactively
Ensure deliverables and artifacts are organized, current, and owned by the right person
Build real fluency in the Sardine product so you can engage as a thought partner on feature requests, not just relay status between the client and the team
Report on project health: deliverable slippage and root cause, dependency risk, and capacity planning across concurrent enterprise engagements

What You'll Need

7+ years of technical program or project management experience, including time spent managing implementations for large enterprise clients
Direct experience working inside or against an enterprise client's formal project management expectations — structured governance, RACI, milestone-based reporting — and the judgment to apply that rigor without over-engineering it for smaller or faster-moving clients
Experience in fintech, payments, fraud, risk, or compliance, ideally at a B2B SaaS company selling into enterprise clients
Comfort acting as a thought partner to Engineering and Product — able to speak credibly enough about technical dependencies and tradeoffs to help unblock and prioritize, not just track status
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical status into language an enterprise client's project office and executive stakeholders will trust
Strong organizational skills and the ability to run multiple concurrent, high-stakes client engagements without dropping details

Benefits We Offer

Job Description

This Opportunity

WSP is currently seeking a Renewables Power Delivery Project Manager
to join the Power & Energy Renewables Project Management department. The position is posted in Denver, CO,
but remote work is allowed from any location in the US (please note desired location in the application).

The position will manage various types of renewables projects with a focus on utility scale wind, solar, storage, and a combination of those. DER, microgrids, EVs, and other similar grid-edge type projects will be a secondary focus. The successful candidate will have a strong interest in renewables work, including High-Voltage Interconnects, and a desire to be a key team member dedicated to growing WSP’s Renewables Project Portfolio.

Your Impact

The successful candidate will manage the technical and financial aspects of Renewables (wind, solar, and BESS) projects, establish and grow client relationships, and market WSP's Renewables services to existing and new clients throughout the US.
The successful candidate will have a technical background in grid-scale renewables projects and will take an active role in coordinating with internal engineering teams needed to execute project work.
Promote company culture and manage internal and external relationships
Lead the project planning process including initiation, design, engineering, material procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout
Manage project implementation including project schedule, project budget, and the project resources including external vendors and contractors
Collaborate with and provide leadership and mentoring to the project design teams
Stay technically engaged in aspects of projects that align with candidate’s experience and interest
Identify key clients and take a lead role in sales and developing those client relationships
This position will include travel to meet with clients throughout the US and occasionally internationally
Demonstrated Project Management skills should include CPM scheduling, budget and cost analysis, managing project teams, as well as proposal writing, client marketing/sales, and project presentations
Responsible for metrics tracking, associated reporting to stakeholders, and compliance with regulatory, corporate, and department procedures during all phases of the project
Collaborate with professionals and leadership from a variety of disciplines to provide “trusted advisor” service and future ready solutions for clients.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, or a related major, or equivalent experience in a technical or engineering firm or 15+ years of relevant post education experience in a project management role within our industry.
5 + years of applicable industry experience as a Project Engineer or Project Manager in the electric utility or renewables market
Advanced experience includes small- to medium-scale project management, and/or project lead engineering experience on large/complex projects
Knowledge and experience with project management processes and tools required
General understanding of both medium- and high-voltage portions of renewables projects
Experience in winning and executing competitive bid work
Client relationship building experience
Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
Strong ability to quickly adapt to change and demonstrate flexibility to a variety of schedules and hours to meet business needs.
Occasional travel may be required depending on project-specific requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

8 + years of experience leading projects as a Project Engineer or Project Manager in the medium or high voltage electrical industry
Solar, wind, and/or storage focused project management and client development experience
Familiarity with renewables developers or EPC contractors
Professional Engineer (PE) registration and/or Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is preferred
Master’s Degree is preferred.
Essential project management certification (e.g., PMP, CAP-M).

WSP Benefits

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

Expected Salary (all locations): $168,900 - $320,000

WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

About WSP

ABOUT US

WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

www.wsp.com

WSP provides a flexible and agile workplace model while meeting client needs. Employees are also afforded a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career.

At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started?

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Do you want to lead complex, large-scale energy projects that modernize critical power infrastructure?

GE Vernova is looking for an exceptional Senior Project Manager to join our Gas Power Service South and East Europe team, remote based in one of the following countries (Spain, Italy, Portugal, Greece, Hungary, Poland).

GE Vernova - The Energy to Change the World

With over 130 years of experience and proven innovation, GE Vernova is leading a new era of energy. We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonize it. Our name reflects our mission. “GE” carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” signals Earth’s lush ecosystems, while “Nova” nods to a new era of lower-carbon energy we are helping to deliver.

Focused on the future, GE Vernova is accelerating the shift to reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy. We help customers power economies and deliver electricity vital to health, safety, and quality of life.

Power

Our Power portfolio provides sustainable, more efficient energy solutions. With expertise across Gas, Hydro, Nuclear, and Steam Power, we help customers deliver electricity to homes, industries, and communities worldwide.

Job Description

Let’s Talk about the Role

The Senior Project Manager will lead high-impact, aftermarket projects that modernize existing power generation assets.

You will own the end-to-end execution of complex upgrades, modifications, and relocations for industrial gas and steam turbines. This is a role for a proactive leader who thrives on integration and technical challenges, serving as the primary advocate for our customers while ensuring our projects meet the highest standards of safety, quality, and financial performance.

How You Will Make a Difference

Leading the end-to-end execution of turnkey power generation service projects, ensuring delivery against contractual, financial, and safety targets.
Building and maintaining trusted relationships with customers, acting as their primary point of contact and driving swift resolution to project challenges.
Creating robust project execution strategies, coordinating cross-functional teams across engineering, procurement, logistics, and field operations.
Managing project financials, including cost forecasting, margin enhancement, and proactive risk mitigation.
Collaborating with internal stakeholders to drive scope and change management, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within specification.
Improving project outcomes by applying Lean management principles and sharing best practices to enhance overall service delivery.

Special Role Requirements

Able to travel to various project sites as required by project needs approximately. 25%.

Skills for Success

You Should Be a Dedicated Project Management Professional With

The ability to lead large-scale, complex industrial service projects with a focus on power generation infrastructure.
The capability to navigate complex contractual terms and manage multi-disciplinary project teams.
An expertise in project financials, risk management, and schedule control.
A keen interest in applying Lean methodologies to optimize project performance and reduce waste.
Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build consensus and influence stakeholders in international and cross-functional settings.

A formal education in Engineering, Business, or a related technical field is a great foundation for this role, and professional project management certification (PMP) or training is highly valued. We are most interested in your proven ability to deliver complex projects and your drive for operational excellence.

Where and how you'll work

This is a permanent position based in Spain, Italy, Portugal, Greece, Hungary, Poland.
We have a hybrid working model which gives you flexibility to work from our offices and from home.

Our Culture

Every action shapes our future. That’s why our north star is a culture of impact, where everyone is empowered to thrive and achieve.

Addressing the urgent need to build a more sustainable electric power system while improving the trajectory of climate change emissions are global priorities, and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify to thrive and decarbonize the world. We play a significant role in leading a new era of energy.

Our technology helps generate approximately twenty-five percent of the world’s electricity today, and we are working to power the rest. If we want the future of energy to be different, then join us and be the difference. Together, we are the Energy of Change!

We're determined to be the best place to grow

We believe that strong careers are built on a variety of experiences, strong connections, and continuous development. We’re committed to providing you the tools to navigate and shape a strong career journey that aligns with a healthy work-life balance. No two careers are the same, and yours should reflect your personal and professional goals. Your people leader and trusted mentors will support you through navigating your journey.

We also prioritize fair pay, performance-based rewards, and wellbeing programs for you and your family. With opportunities to move across teams and functions, your career can keep evolving while sustainability stays at the core of everything we do.

Inclusion & Diversity

jobs.title: Associate Program Manager - Data Center Construction
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

Turner & Townsend is seeking an Associate Program Manager
to support pre-lease technical due diligence for a confidential hyperscale data center client. You will work under a Program Manager to keep a portfolio of live deals organized, on track, and moving, while building toward ownership of your own deals.

This is an execution and organization role that builds into program management. You will own the tracking, follow-up, and day-to-day structure across every deal you support, sit in on every deal call as the account's backstop, and progressively take on direct ownership of workstreams and sites as you demonstrate the judgment to run them. Deals move on short exclusivity windows and incomplete information. We are looking for people who bring order to that rather than waiting for it to settle.

Prior program or project coordination experience is expected. Data center, real estate, or construction exposure is a plus but not required. This is not an executive assistant role and not a purely administrative function. It is the operational backbone of the diligence process, and a defined path into full program management.

This role reports to a Program Manager and is based in San Francisco, with other locations and remote considered for the right candidate.

Responsibilities

Tracking and follow-up:
Own the action item log across every meeting on your accounts. Assign owners, chase status, and close items out, escalating anything that stalls.
Risk log management:
Keep the risk register current for every site in your portfolio. Log new findings, confirm each has an owner and a next step, and follow up until closed.
Meeting management:
Build and distribute the agenda ahead of every standing call, keep it on track, and issue a recap and minutes the same day.
Deliverable tracking:
Track what is due from consultants and developers across every workstream, and chase it before it is late, not after.
Deal awareness and backstop:
Participate in every deal call across your portfolio. Serve as the backstop for each deal, whether you own it or not: know what is happening, what the open issues and risks are, and what needs to happen next. Backstop means knowing it and flagging it, not making the final call on it.
Communication and systems:
Keep the shared trackers and communication channels clean, concise, and accurate so the Program Manager, the client, and other account partners can find what they need without asking you first.
Client and reporting support:
Draft the first pass of client reports and status updates for the Program Manager to edit, so they are reacting to a draft, not starting from a blank page.
Process and tools:
Build and maintain the checklists and templates the account runs on, and improve them yourself when you find a gap.
Deal ownership:
As you ramp, take direct ownership of full workstreams or lower-complexity sites end to end, bringing judgment calls to the Program Manager until you have earned the room to make more of them yourself.
Escalation:
Raise anything that looks wrong the same day it surfaces. Do not sit on an open question hoping it resolves itself.

SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

Qualifications

Minimum 3 to 5 years of relevant experience. A degree is not required.
Prefer candidates that are located in/near San Francisco, CA that can come to the office 2 to 3 days a week but will consider remote for the right candidates.

Program or project coordination experience preferred. Data center, real estate, or construction backgrounds are a plus.
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, low-information environment, with the organizational instinct to bring structure to it.
Strong written and verbal communication, with the polish to represent the account directly to clients and developer counterparties.
A working understanding of, or willingness to quickly learn, what a data center is and how one gets built, including power, cooling, and long lead equipment.
Enough command of program tracking and risk management to keep a portfolio organized without oversight.
Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and reprioritize with incomplete information.
A self starter who takes initiative, adapts quickly, and does not wait for a playbook.
Technologically proficient, including MS Suite and Google Workspace. Comfort building and maintaining tracking tools is an advantage.
Be able to understand and follow site HSSE policies.

Project/Program Specifications

Market sector experience:
Data center development, mission critical facilities, or complex technical and hyperscale buildings preferred, not required.
Program specific responsibilities:
Tracking, follow-up, meeting management, and risk log ownership across a portfolio of concurrent sites, building toward direct site ownership.
Software specific requirements:
MS Suite and Google Workspace. General technological proficiency expected.
Travel:
Minimal, approximately [TBD] days per month.

Additional Information

The salary range for this role is $100,000 - $130,000. This range reflects the company's good faith estimate of the base salary for this position at the time of the posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, employees may be eligible for bonuses and a comprehensive benefits package.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs.

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

jobs.description:
Need help with applying? Visit our Talent Acquisition page here for application guidance and resources.

VISION

El Paso County will be a trusted regional leader known for excellence in county service delivery.

PURPOSE

We provide essential public services to the Pikes Peak Region in support of our residents, businesses, and communities, enhancing the freedom for all to thrive.

VALUES

Service Focused

Collaborative
Accountable
Trustworthy
Transparent

Job Summary

Anticipated Term Duration September 2026 – November 2027

Build the Playbook for a Program That Protects Everyone!

El Paso County Public Health's Environmental Health Division is hiring a full-time, term-limited Project

Manager — and this one is unusual: you won't be maintaining a system someone else built, you'll be

creating it. Our Retail Food Program keeps food safe across the county and it does that work today without

the standard operating procedures and guidance tools that would let it run at its best. You'd partner with

our Retail Food Program Public Health Manager to capture what currently lives in people's heads and turn

it into clear, repeatable process, while also helping move division priorities forward like our SharePoint

migration and agency-wide ADA compliance updates.

The timing is intentional. CDPHE will assess our Retail Food Program in the coming months, and we're

recruiting now so our new Project Manager can take part — learning the program from the inside and

helping shape the improvements that follow. The position runs through November 2027, and the playbook

you build will outlast the term. If you do your best work in ambiguity and like turning scattered knowledge

into something people can actually use, we'd like to hear from you. Apply today.

Hiring Range: $90,000.00 - $96,000.00 annually

This is an in-person position and is not eligible for remote work.

This position has an anticipated work schedule of Monday – Friday, 8:00am – 4:30pm, subject to change.

Please be advised this position may close without advance notice, should we receive a sufficient number of qualified applications.

Manages cross-sector projects; coordinates, directs, communicates, and implements projects through the development of project plans, including scope, budget, deliverables, timelines, and success metrics. Employment is subject to the terms, conditions, and policies detailed in the Personnel Policies Manual (PPM). This position requires regular in-person presence as an essential job function.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities

Develops/builds project plans from start to finish; coordinates, directs, communicates, and implements project plans; collaborates with leadership to ensure successful delivery of scope, budget, and schedule of projects and plans; performs detailed analysis to evaluate the effectiveness of special projects.
Identifies project needs and manages operational enhancement; manages budget; develops and estimates required resources; sets project development priorities and schedules; anticipates project success through the effective delivery of high-quality processes that address continuous improvement.
Monitors, manages, and projects future project costs for budget purposes and analysis. Facilitates problem-solving activities with the project team and engages appropriate resources to reach solutions. Acts as a technical expert in a functional area, provides consultative and technical guidance to managers and other stakeholders, and handles sensitive and confidential issues, complaints, or inquiries as they relate to the project.
Collaborates with department staff to develop and manage community outreach, education, and communication efforts to ensure department programming and project plans are represented appropriately and comprehensively.
Provides strategic planning, professional learning, and communication support to department staff; facilitates coordination of event outreach and planning by utilizing research-based project management tools and processes; ensures programmatic materials, department policies and procedures, and published postings are kept up-to-date and align to County standards; collects and analyzes success metric data to evaluate the effectiveness of project plans.
Collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to develop and plan strategic projects.
Develops, analyzes, and submits research on project needs; compiles data to prepare written/statistical reports; synthesizes multiple data sources and/or stakeholder insights to inform the development of project plans; researches, develops, writes, and advances comprehensive short- and long-term plans for the department.
May participate in community-level planning groups, committees, and/or commissions; builds relationships with key stakeholders and serves as a liaison to the community. Presents program or project opportunities to small and large groups.
May provide functional guidance to staff involved in projects.
Performs other duties as required.

Supervision Exercised:
This classification does not have supervisory authority; however, may be required to provide expertise or limited guidance or direction to employees, such as overseeing work quality, training, and guidance. Typically serves as a subject matter expert on the scope of functional area.

Supervision Received:
Receives general supervision. This classification typically performs job duties by following established standard operating procedures and/or policies. Regular direction, guidance, and coaching from supervisor may be expected. There is a choice of the appropriate procedure or policy to apply to duties. Performance reviewed periodically.

Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Knowledge, skills, and abilities regarding the principles, practices, and procedures related to planning and professional project management.
Knowledge of scope and application of Local, State, and Federal laws and regulations pertaining to assigned functional area.
Must exercise considerable judgment and initiative in combining a broad scope of professional planning and content knowledge and sophisticated, analytical judgments to solve a variety of complex, technical problems; must work independently and in teams.
Strong organizational and time management skills with attention to detail; must possess good grammar, spelling, and punctuation skills.
Exceptional interpersonal communication and public speaking skills, negotiation skills, and ability to cultivate effective working relationships with County staff, elected officials, Federal/State officials, the public, and other stakeholders to elicit engagement. Ability to provide excellent customer service.
Ability to utilize software that compiles and analyzes economic data and utilizes project management tools; ability to write concise, logical, and grammatically correct analytical reports.
Ability to comprehend complex financial issues and recommend/implement targeted solutions; ability to manage budgets.
Ability to operate computers and standard office equipment, working knowledge of Microsoft Office tools.
Maintain regular and punctual attendance.

Required Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree required in related field.
Four years of related professional experience may substitute for the required degree.

Two years of project management or related experience.

Licenses/Certificates

Must possess and maintain a valid driver's license.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification issued by Project Management Institute preferred.

Pre-Employment Requirements

Must pass conditional post offer background investigation, motor vehicle record check, and drug screen.

Work Conditions

Duties are primarily performed in an office and remote work environment dependent upon Department discretion and business needs; some travel may be required.

Minimum qualifications reflect the baseline experience required for the classification. Specific job assignments, duties, education, experience, licenses/certifications, and working conditions may vary based on the department or office's needs and the requirements of the assigned position. Changes to this classification specification may only be made by the Human Resources Department.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager – Silicon Co-Design
jobs.description:
NVIDIA's Silicon Co-Design Group (SCG) sits at the intersection of architecture, silicon, systems, and manufacturing — where engineering judgment at the highest level drives real-world product outcomes at scale.

We are hiring a Senior TPM who doesn't just lead programs but shapes them: A Senior TPM who has owned SoC programs from architecture through tape-out, bring-up, and productization—not by coordinating meetings, but by owning outcomes, schedules, and trade-offs. They combine deep hands-on knowledge of bring-up and validation with the judgment to see integration risks across silicon, systems, and software, and they drive alignment across engineering, operations, and product without deferring hard calls. They operate effectively when requirements and architecture are still changing. They identify dependencies and misalignment early, before crises develop. They close risks with mitigation plans that engineers respect. They improve how the organization completes work after each program. They are credible on silicon hardware logistics (silicon, boards, peripherals), so validation and bring-up stay unblocked. The exceptional hire also uses AI deliberately: they have hands-on experience with AI-powered program management tools (e.g., automated status, risk, and dependency signals) and can tell what improves outcomes versus what adds noise. This role requires on-site teamwork in Santa Clara, a minimum of three days per week.

What You'll Be Doing

Own program outcomes end-to-end — define and manage schedules, surface dependencies before they block work, and drive multi-functional alignment from architecture review through tape-out and bring-up; you’re accountable for delivery, not only oversight.
Lead through design complexity — take part in critical design reviews, flag scope risks early, resolve them with minimal disruption, and make trade-off calls others will depend on.
Be the connective tissue — act as the main technical link among silicon, systems, software, operations, and marketing; keep teams aligned on program goals and GTM needs, and catch misalignment before it hurts the program.
Drive risk to closure — find technical and schedule risks early, build mitigations with engineering, and move work forward with clarity and context, not only status.
Raise the execution bar — capture lessons from finished programs and put in place process changes that measurably improve speed, quality, and predictability on later programs.
Handle silicon hardware logistics — coordinate movement, tracking, and availability of silicon, boards, and peripherals so validation and bring-up stay unblocked.

What We Need To See

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience); a master’s is a plus
12+ years in technical roles, with at least 5 years in technical program management — ideally driving SoC programs from bring-up through productization
Deep, hands-on understanding of SoC bring-up, validation, and productization — you know the stages, what each involves, and what can go wrong
Ability to work across the silicon–system–software boundary — enough depth in each area to spot integration risks and drive fixes without having to be the expert on every technical question
Proven track record to run fast development cycles in uncertainty — you develop transparency instead of waiting for it
Communication that is precise, direct, and right-sized for the audience
On-site in Santa Clara, CA, a minimum of three days per week

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Used AI-style program management tools (e.g., automated status, risk flagging, dependency tracking) and can tell which tools help outcomes vs add noise
Experience working with AI/ML teams on inference infrastructure and aligning multi-functional work with go-to-market timing for AI-accelerated products
Experience with AI-assisted logistics tracking to speed bring-up and reduce manual efforts, including where those approaches stop being reliable
Can evaluate and help roll out new AI productivity tools (coding assistants, automated documentation) and make a clear case for what actually improves engineering velocity

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 200,000 USD - 322,000 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

jobs.title: Enterprise Service Program Manager (East Zone)
jobs.description:
Job Title

Enterprise Service Program Manager (East Zone)

Job Description

As an individual contributor in this Enterprise Service Program Manager role, you will serve as the main corporate and customer/facility point of contact. Your responsibilities will include overall customer partnership management, strategic customer governance, delivering effective customer business reviews, understanding key customer objectives, and accountability for tactical daily performance management (ie. managing service escalations, providing reporting, delivering value, etc.). The role is essential to drive initiatives to ensure best in class benefits delivery for the supported customer (Integrated Delivery Network (IDN)).

Your Role

As an Enterprise Service Program Manager, you will manage the overall customer partnerships and have accountability for all aspects of the customer partnership. You will manage relationships with key individual customer stakeholders as well as act with a consulting mindset and be an advocate for your customer.
You will establish and enforce governance between Philips and the customer to ensure partnership objectives are aligned and progress is on track.
You will partner internally with your sales, service, and delivery colleagues to lead the change from an operating paradigm centered on break-fix to one focused on customer solutions.
You will promote compliance, and operational performance, driving accountability using metrics and analytics. Create and encourage initiatives to change when necessary to maximize productivity, effectiveness, and the successful execution of contractual obligations.
You will communicate the customer business plan to our stakeholders, providing a link between the tasks and responsibility of field teams, and supporting initiatives to promote higher field productivity and benefits delivery with a common objective of customer satisfaction. Own and direct company strategy and outcomes, through the deployment of our IDN service strategy to win over clients.
You will manage multiple small multi-site programs, creating synergy between the project in the program(s) and monitor future work to proactively adjust program management plans and resource focus. Identify trends and potential scheduling challenges, manage cross-project dependencies within and across the enterprise and leverage metrics and monitoring to proactively identify at-risk projects/programs and strategically escalate well-defined risks/issues/impediments to appropriate decision-makers.
Use cross-functional cooperation and collaboration to identify growth opportunities while managing risk (such install base, multi-vendor, Hospital Patient Monitoring, IGT, Ultrasound, etc.), while driving productivity and managing the IDN business's financial performance.

You're The Right Fit If

You’ve acquired 5+ years of customer facing experience within healthcare and with routine client interaction as a customer success or account manager (required); in addition to, 5+ years’ experience and understanding of Medical equipment (required).
Your skills include proficiency in creating and delivering presentations to key stakeholders and executive leaders; MS Office (Excel and PowerPoint skills are a must); comfortable facilitating tactical meetings, etc. You are well versed in data analysis and reporting (required) and have an understanding of healthcare service metrics (preferred).
You have a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of related work experience. ITIL and/or Customer Success certification preferred.
You must be able to successfully perform the following minimum Physical, Cognitive and Environmental job requirements with or without accommodation for this position.
You’re an excellent communicator (listening, presenting, concise verbal skills) and collaborator with strong interpersonal skills (build and maintain strong relationships). You are also a well-organized multi-tasker, skilled at working with tight deadlines, establishing priorities, using sound judgement to make decisions and find solutions, and take initiative to diffuse tense situations if needed. Must be flexible on working hours to mirror customer time zones (if needed) and be able to travel to customer locations. Must be located within one hour of a major airport.

How We Work Together

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

This is a field-based role.

About Philips

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

Learn more about our business.
Discover our rich and exciting history.
Learn more about our purpose.
Learn more about our culture.

US work authorization is a precondition of employment. The company will not consider candidates who require sponsorship for a work-authorized visa, now or in the future.

Company relocation benefits will not
be provided for this position.

NOTE: This is a non-sales related opportunity. For this opening, we are looking for a candidate to cover hospital accounts and reside in the East Zone.

Philips Transparency Details

jobs.title: Gestionnaire Senior du programme de produits / Senior Product Program Manager
jobs.description:
English Version to Follow

Qui sommes-nous?

XNRGY Climate Systems est un chef de file nord-américain dans la conception durable et la fabrication de pointe de systèmes de traitement d'air sur mesure. Axés sur la recherche et le développement énergétique, nous contribuons à la réduction de l'empreinte carbone dans de nombreux secteurs d'activité.

Nous sommes fiers d'annoncer l'ouverture de notre nouveau siège social technologique à Mesa, en Arizona. Cette expansion témoigne de notre engagement envers la croissance, l'innovation et le développement de solutions climatiques durables.

L'opportunité

Aperçu du poste

Le ou la gestionnaire du programme de produits est un leader clé de l’exécution responsable de coordonner l’ensemble du cycle de vie de systèmes thermiques sur mesure à haut rendement, depuis le lancement de la commande jusqu’à la préparation à l’expédition. Agissant comme lien essentiel entre la conception et la livraison physique du produit, cette personne assure l’exécution interfonctionnelle entre les équipes d’Ingénierie, de Fabrication, de Chaîne d’approvisionnement, de Logistique et de Qualité.

La personne idéale ne se contente pas d’assurer le suivi des tâches; elle prend en charge les risques liés aux programmes, favorise la préparation opérationnelle, remet en question les écarts d’exécution et garantit que les engagements pris envers les clients sont livrés à temps, dans le respect du budget et selon les plus hauts standards de qualité.

Principales responsabilités – Incluant, sans s’y limiter

Définir et diriger la stratégie d’exécution de bout en bout pour plusieurs projets complexes et à forte valeur ajoutée, de l’étude de faisabilité initiale jusqu’à la préparation à l’expédition, tout en protégeant les échéanciers, la qualité et les marges.
Valider la faisabilité de l’exécution avant l’engagement interne des programmes, notamment en ce qui concerne le réalisme des échéanciers, la maturité de l’ingénierie et les contraintes de fabrication.
Remettre en question l’état de préparation de l’ingénierie et exercer l’autorité nécessaire pour interrompre la progression lorsqu’une conception n’a pas atteint le niveau de maturité requis pour la production.
Assurer une préparation complète à la production, incluant l’exactitude des nomenclatures (BOM), la disponibilité des matériaux et la capacité des ressources; superviser les étapes critiques de validation telles que les essais d’acceptation en usine (FAT) et les inspections qualité.
Diriger la gouvernance complète des programmes, incluant les rencontres quotidiennes d’alignement de l’exécution, les réunions hebdomadaires de coordination interfonctionnelle et les rapports mensuels destinés à la direction.
Agir comme point central de l’exécution à travers l’organisation en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes des Ventes, de l’Approvisionnement, de l’Ingénierie, de la Qualité, de la Production et du Service sur le terrain afin d’assurer une discipline opérationnelle rigoureuse, du lancement de la commande à la livraison finale.
Contribuer à la définition, au déploiement et à l’amélioration continue des outils, modèles et standards d’exécution en gestion de programmes produits chez XNRGY.

Qualifications Requises

Baccalauréat en génie, en gestion de la construction, en gestion des opérations ou dans un domaine technique connexe.
Plus de 10 ans d’expérience en gestion de projets ou de programmes dans un environnement complexe, idéalement dans les secteurs manufacturier, industriel ou CVAC (HVAC).
Expérience démontrée dans la gestion de programmes complexes comprenant plusieurs projets et des budgets de plusieurs millions de dollars, avec une responsabilité claire quant à la stratégie du programme et à la reddition de comptes auprès de la haute direction.
Excellente capacité à mobiliser, aligner et responsabiliser des équipes matricielles et interfonctionnelles sans autorité hiérarchique directe.
Solide sens des affaires et aptitude démontrée à équilibrer les risques, les coûts et les échéanciers afin de prendre des décisions stratégiques sous pression et dans des délais serrés.

Qualifications Privilégiées

Maîtrise en génie, en gestion de projets, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe.
Certification PMP (Project Management Professional), Lean Six Sigma, PRINCE2 ou toute autre certification reconnue en gestion de programmes et en résolution de problèmes.
Expérience dans les secteurs des centrales de traitement d’air sur mesure, de la gestion thermique ou du refroidissement liquide, particulièrement pour des environnements critiques comme les centres de données hyperscale, les établissements de santé ou les salles blanches.
Expérience démontrée dans le déploiement ou la mise à l’échelle de cadres de gouvernance de bureau de gestion de projets (PMO) et de modèles opérationnels au sein d’une organisation en forte croissance et en transformation.
Expérience directe des cycles d’introduction de nouveaux produits (NPI) ou de la transition de prototypes sur mesure vers des processus de fabrication standardisés.

Pourquoi joindre XNRGY?

Chez XNRGY Climate Systems, nous sommes déterminés à créer un environnement de travail inclusif où la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives favorise l'innovation et la réussite.

Nous recherchons des personnes passionnées par le développement durable, désireuses de contribuer à un avenir plus respectueux de l'environnement.

Prêt(e) à relever le défi?

Joignez-vous à une entreprise qui valorise le Courage
, la Communauté
, le Climat
, le Client
et la Cohérence
.

Participez à bâtir notre avenir et faites partie d'une équipe gagnante!

Who We Are

XNRGY Climate Systems is a North American leader in sustainable design and advanced manufacturing of custom air handling systems. Focused on energy research and development, we help reduce the carbon footprint across many industries.

We are proud to announce the opening of our new technology headquarters in Mesa, Arizona. This expansion reflects our commitment to growth, innovation, and the development of sustainable climate solutions.

The Opportunity

The Sr
. Product Program Manager (Sr. Product PM)
is a critical execution leader responsible for orchestrating the lifecycle of custom, high-performance thermal systems from initial order release through shipment-readiness. Serving as the vital bridge between design and physical delivery, this role manages the cross-functional execution across Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Quality.

The ideal candidate does not just track tasks; they own program risk, drive operational readiness, challenge execution gaps, and guarantee that what is promised to the customer is built on time, on budget, and to the highest quality standards.

Key Responsibilities – Including But Not Limited To

Drive the end-to-end execution strategy for multiple high-value, complex projects from initial feasibility through shipment readiness, safeguarding schedule, quality, and margin protection.
Validate execution feasibility before programs are committed internally - including schedule realism, engineering maturity, and manufacturing constraints.
Challenge engineering readiness, and exercise the authority to halt progression if designs lack the maturity needed for production
Ensure complete production readiness, including BOM accuracy, material availability, and resource capacity; oversee critical validation steps like Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and quality inspections
Lead comprehensive program governance, including daily execution alignment, weekly cross-functional syncs, and monthly executive reporting.
Serve as the central execution anchor across the business, collaborating seamlessly with Sales, Sourcing, Engineering, Quality, Production, and Field Service teams to drive operational discipline from order release to final delivery
Contribute to the definition, rollout, and continuous improvement of XNRGY’s Product Program Management tools, templates, and execution standards.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Operations, or a closely related technical field
10+ years of dedicated project or program management experience within a complex environment – ideally manufacturing, industrial, HVAC
Proven track record of managing complex, multi-project programs with budgets exceeding several million dollars, with clear ownership of program strategy and executive-level reporting
Exceptional ability to lead, align, and drive accountability across matrixed, cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
Sound business acumen with a proven ability to balance risk, cost, and schedule to make high-stakes, timely decisions under pressure.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in in Engineering, Project Management, Business Administration, or a related field
Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean Six Sigma, Prince2, or other Program Management and problem-solving credentials.
Experience in the custom Air handling, thermal management, or liquid cooling sectors: particularly servicing mission-critical environments like hyperscale data centers, healthcare, or cleanrooms.
Demonstrated experience deploying, or scaling PMO governance frameworks and operating models within a fast-growth, evolving organization
Direct experience with New Product Introduction (NPI) cycles or transitioning custom prototypes to standardized manufacturing processes.

Why Join XNRGY?
At XNRGY Climate Systems, we are committed to creating an inclusive work environment where diversity of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives drives innovation and success.

We are looking for people who are passionate about sustainability and eager to contribute to a more environmentally responsible future.

Ready for the challenge?
Join a company that values Courage, Community, Climate, Customer, and Consistency
.

Be part of building our future and join a winning team!

jobs.title: Program Manager (Airside Operations)
jobs.description:
About This Position

Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX) served approximately 52 million passengers in 2025, making it one of the busiest airports in the nation and a major commercial aviation hub for the country's fifth largest city. PHX is the largest of three airports in the Phoenix Airport System along with Deer Valley and Goodyear operated by the City of Phoenix Aviation Department (AVN). Collectively, these airports generate an estimated $38 billion annual economic impact.

The Airside Operations Section ensures PHX's airfield operates safely, efficiently, and in full compliance with Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) regulations, including FAR Part 139. Airside Operations oversees daily aircraft movement areas, inspections, safety programs, operational coordination, NOTAM issuance, airfield construction impacts, and regulatory documentation critical to maintaining PHX's Part 139 certification and 24/7 operational readiness.

The Aviation Department is seeking an Airside Operations Program Manager to provide program level leadership across airfield regulatory programs, oversee operational coordination, and manage compliance initiatives that directly support airfield safety and efficiency. This role serves as a key leader in the Airside Operations Section, responsible for aligning airfield programs with departmental goals, supervising multiple operational units, and advancing strategic initiatives that sustain PHX's reputation as a world class airport.

Airside Operations employs field staff, supervisors, and program leaders who support PHX's constant airfield activity. The Airside Operations Program Manager will be instrumental in regulatory compliance, operational excellence, employee development, and cross divisional coordination that strengthens PHX's airfield performance.

Key Duties Include

Program & Strategic Leadership

Provide program-level direction for FAA Part 139 compliance, ensuring policies, inspections, documentation, and safety evaluations meet regulatory requirements.
Lead development of airfield programs aligned with AVN¿s strategic goals, including inspection tracking, safety initiatives, and operational performance measures.
Coordinate program updates, compliance documentation, and strategic recommendations for Section and Division leadership.

Airside Operations & Daily Coordination

Direct and support daily airfield operations to maintain safe and efficient aircraft movement consistent with FAA and airport standards.
Provide expert guidance on complex operational challenges impacting safety, customer service, and regulatory compliance.
Oversee special events, VIP aircraft movements, and irregular operations requiring cross-agency coordination.

Regulatory Compliance & Safety Programs

Manage daily implementation of FAA Part 139 requirements, including inspections, safety risk management, and corrective actions.
Participate in FAA Safety Risk Management (SRM) panels to support hazard identification and mitigation strategies.
Oversee Construction Safety and Phasing Plans (CSPPs) for all airfield construction projects.
Support daily management of the Safety Management System (SMS).

Contractor, Construction, and Project Coordination

Coordinate operational impacts of airfield construction with Engineering, Facilities, contractors, and FAA representatives.
Review and provide guidance on construction phasing, closures, and NOTAM issuance.
Support integration of airfield operational needs into project planning.

Team Development & Collaboration

Supervise Airside Operations Supervisor II positions and provide indirect oversight for Airside Operations Assistants.
Lead recruitment, performance management, and workforce development initiatives.
Coordinate cross-divisional collaboration supporting operational readiness.

Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement

Prepare and present airfield program updates, compliance reports, and operational analyses.
Maintain communication with airlines, tenants, FAA representatives, and contractors.

IDEAL CANDIDATE

Knowledge of the aviation industry.
Familiar with technical writing.
Proficient communicator and capable of managing multiple projects successfully.
Proficient decision-making skills and effective at problem-solving and compliance resolution.
Ability to communication orally and in the English language with customers, clients, and the public in face-to-face, one-on-one, and in group settings.
Strong knowledge of FAA regulations, Safety Management System (SMS) principles, airport construction impacts, and NOTAM processes.
Strong analytical, reporting, and policy development skills with the ability to present clear and concise information to leadership and stakeholder groups.
Demonstrated three (3) years of experience managing FAA Part 139 compliance programs, airfield inspections, and safety risk mitigation activities.

SALARY

Pay Range: $102,232.00 to $137,009.60 annually.

Hiring Range: $102,232.00 to $124,259.20 annually.

Benefits

Traditional pension with employer and employee contributions, click here for more details: Pension Information.
401(a) and 457 plans with employer contributions.
Choice of generous medical HMO, PPO, or HSA/HDHP plans.

Free Bus/light rail pass.
Tuition reimbursement program up to $6,500 per year.
Paid time off includes 13.5 paid holidays, 12 vacation days, and 15 sick days and personal leave days.
Paid Parental Leave for eligible employees up to 480 hours (12 weeks) of paid leave for the birth, adoption, or foster care placement of a child during a 12-month period.

To develop, implement, improve, and manage assigned programs. The Program Manager I is

responsible for the overall success for the assigned program(s) and their role extends beyond

completion of individual tasks. Programs are ongoing, which may include aligned projects and

requires strategic planning and continuous improvement efforts after program startup.

tracking, and reporting.

conclusions to make recommendations to leadership.

and action items.

 Responsible for program evaluation and continuous improvement activities.

 Responsible for the successful implementation of new and assigned programs and their

associated processes.

 Participates in the design, implementation, and/or expansion of strategic programs and

departmental initiatives.

 Utilizes established software, tools, and resources needed for program execution and

oversight

 Leads user demos, trainings and setup as assigned

 Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

management experience required. In lieu of degree, a minimum of

Certifications

Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, to interpret and

articulate program requirements to involved stakeholders. Exceptional

interpersonal and customer service skills. Ability to establish and

maintain effective working relationships across all levels within the

organization. Detail-oriented. Strong organization skills with ability to

prioritize assignments and manage time effectively. Strong decisionmaking, problem solving, and critical thinking skills. Able to work

under pressure and meet critical deadlines in a fast-moving

environment. Adaptable to a continuous changing environment.

Required. Proficient Experience In Use Of Various Computer System

software including Windows, Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, Visio,

and PowerPoint. Valid California driver’s license and proof of current

automobile insurance compliant with Partnership policy are required to

operate a vehicle and travel for company business.

Knowledge of business practices and protocols with ability to access

data and information using automated systems. Ability to participate in

team based projects. Strong organizational skills with ability to

prioritize assignments and maintain effective filing systems and meet

deadlines. Strong attention to detail; critical thinking/listening and

communication skills.

More than 50% of work time is spent using a desktop computer. When

necessary, the ability to lift, carry, or move objects of varying size,

weighing up to 10 lbs.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager - Security
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We are hiring a Staff Technical Program Manager
for our Security
organization. Security at Snowflake spans Product Security, Database Security, Threat Detection, and Compliance — the teams responsible for protecting the world's most sensitive data at the scale of one of the world's most trusted cloud platforms. This is a highly visible, high-impact role for a senior TPM who thrives at the intersection of technical depth and organizational influence.

Program Ownership & Backlog Management

Lead strategic, high-ambiguity Security programs from inception through execution, turning 0-to-1 initiatives into structured, measurable outcomes.
Own executive-facing operating mechanisms for the Security org, including planning, execution reviews, SteerCos, strategy summits, design and product reviews, QBRs and leadership decision forums.
Build and scale execution rituals across Security teams, partnering with Engineering, Product, and TPM to strengthen accountability, visibility, and operational discipline.
Drive portfolio-level strategy, sequencing, and dependency management across critical Security initiatives, ensuring clear prioritization, resource alignment, and timely escalation of risks and tradeoffs.
Establish strong program governance across the Security portfolio, including reporting cadence, decision-making frameworks, escalation paths, risk tracking, and executive communications.
Coach and mentor Security TPMs, helping raise the bar for program strategy, communication, stakeholder management, and execution excellence.

Technical & Product Depth

Build technical and product depth to understand Security architecture choices, evaluate tradeoffs, and anticipate downstream implications and risks.
Bridge engineering execution with customer outcomes and product strategy, ensuring Security programs are aligned with both technical priorities and business impact.
Engage deeply in architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical tradeoff conversations, helping teams pressure-test assumptions and make well-informed decisions.
Raise the bar in program reviews by asking high-quality technical and product questions, identifying gaps, and driving teams toward crisp decisions and accountable follow-through.
Translate complex technical topics into clear narratives for cross-functional and executive audiences.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

The estimated base salary range for this role is $194,000 - $278,300.
Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending & health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits.

jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Lead the manufacturing support for Data Center AI accelerator boards, solving complex problems. Assist in delivering advanced AI accelerators across various industries in collaboration with Operations Program Managers.

What You'll Be Doing

Planning, coordinating, and tracking manufacturing progress to the stated program goals.
Collaborating with Engineering and Diagnostics teams to coordinate product Firmware and test diagnostics upgrades.
Coordinating and managing customer qualifications where significant product changes are necessary, in collaboration with customer PMs and engineering.
Devise and implement an NPI handover strategy for ramping new designs into mass production, in close consultation with NPI OPMs and Product Development Engineering.
Using strong communication and influencing skills to drive regular alignment and succinct updates to the factory network.
Ensuring continuous alignment between the factory and key collaborators on production execution strategy and engineering work progress.
Leading and coordinating teams, materials, and resources to proactively minimize production risks and swiftly resolve day-to-day issues.
Driving systemic process improvement, owning technology issue resolution, and developing risk mitigation strategies with the Platform Design Engineering teams.
Coordinating the supply chain and manufacturing plan of record for revenue products.
Maintaining project budgets and tracking procurement and delivery of bring-up hardware to facilitate the engineering teams.

What We Need To See

BS degree or equivalent experience in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering preferred.
8+ years of experience in program management/production within the server industry.
Leadership – ability to influence and drive the correct behaviors, negotiate your position, and make and defend solid data-driven decisions.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to detail and clearly articulate the status and final project deliveries at all levels of the organization.
Prior work involvement in technical program, project, or product management position within the server domain is favored.
Pragmatic problem-solving skills, comfortable with making informed decisions or escalating, as necessary.
Fast issue resolution through out-of-the-box thinking.
Ability to thrive and adapt in a fast-paced environment.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Project Management Professional Certification a plus.
Technical depth in hardware and software development techniques.
In-depth knowledge of factory production techniques and test strategies.
Direct experience delivering complex products to cloud-based customers.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 258,750 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

jobs.title: Egov Select - Senior IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
Bij Egov Select vind je een innovatieve kijk op ICT-dienstverlening met maatschappelijke relevantie. Als autonome organisatie ondersteunen we de federale overheidsdiensten bij hun zoektocht naar gespecialiseerde en gekwalificeerde ICT-medewerkers.

Wil je in een boeiende omgeving
werken met uitdagingen die verbonden zijn aan de informatisering van diensten en daarbij ook nog een meerwaarde creëren
voor de maatschappij ? Dan is een ICT job binnen één van onze openbare diensten een job voor jou. We streven naar een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé
(bijvoorbeeld dankzij de mogelijkheid van telewerken, flexibele werkuren, gemakkelijk bereikbare gebouwen) en bieden een marktconform salaris
- inclusief een hele reeks extralegale voordelen.

Egov Select - Senior IT Project Manager

Ref. 1357

De FOD Beleid en Ondersteuning (BOSA) speelt binnen de federale administratie een sleutelrol in het uitbouwen van een moderne overheid ten dienste van burgers en ondernemingen. Opgericht op 1 maart 2017, ondersteunt de Federale Overheidsdienst (FOD) Beleid en Ondersteuning - ook wel “FOD BOSA” genoemd - de regering en de federale organisaties in diverse domeinen: IT, HR, organisatiebeheer en integriteitsbeleid, begroting, boekhouding en overheidsopdrachten.

De FOD BOSA draagt als centrale speler bij tot een moderne administratie die burgers en bedrijven optimaal bedient. Meer informatie over de FOD BOSA (missie, visie, waarden, organigram).

De DG Vereenvoudiging en Digitalisering (DG Vd) heeft als opdracht om de dienstverlening aan burgers en bedrijven te digitaliseren en te vereenvoudigen, en het ontwikkelen van digitale diensten voor de overheid en ondernemingen te ondersteunen.

Binnen de DG Vd stelt het departement “Digitale interacties met burgers en Toegankelijkheid” het platform Fast2web ter beschikking van de verschillende federale overheidsdiensten (FOD's). Deze dienst staat in voor het creëren, hosten, onderhouden en ondersteunen van meer dan 220 federale websites, waaronder het merendeel van de FOD-websites.

Functieomschrijving

Als Senior Project Manager vorm je de schakel tussen IT en Business en weet je teams te aligneren rond duidelijke doelstellingen, in een iteratieve en veranderlijke context.

Je Takenpakket Omvat Onder Meer

Coördinatie van de support- en onderhoudsteams van het F2w-platform:
Het aansturen en coördineren van de activiteiten van het supportteam en het team dat instaat voor het onderhoud.
Het organiseren en leiden van teamvergaderingen en het opvolgen van Agile-sessies (stand-ups, reviews, evaluatiemomenten).
Het opvolgen en plannen van de volgende belangrijke stappen (ontwikkelingssprints) en het waarborgen van de kwaliteit van de sprintdeliverables.
Het bewaken van prioriteiten en het oplossen van problemen.
Het organiseren van coördinatievergaderingen met andere teams en betrokken stakeholders.

Organisatie van de support- en onderhoudsteams voor Fast2web (F2w):
Opstellen van een roadmap voor de verdere ontwikkeling van het Drupal-Openfed-platform (en opvolging ervan).
Opstellen en opvolgen van projectplanningen, inclusief toewijzing van middelen.
Voorstellen van prioriteiten ter goedkeuring door het management en het maken van keuzes tussen concurrerende aanvragen en transversale thema's.
Definiëren en documenteren van operationele procedures voor het beheer van onderhouds- en supportaanvragen, met het oog op kwaliteitsverbetering van de dienstverlening.
Organiseren van wekelijkse reviews, eerst met de IT-architect en vervolgens met het BOSA-team (CAB), om activiteiten voor de komende onderhoudscycli (sprints) te bepalen en goed te keuren.
Beheren van change requests en het systematisch opvolgen van scope, timing en kwaliteit.
Escalaties uitvoeren wanneer nodig en afwijkingen beheren binnen de vastgelegde tolerantiedrempels van het project.
Voorbereiden van stuurgroepen en executive rapporten om besluitvorming te faciliteren.
Regelmatig rapporteren over voortgang en risico's aan het management, de stuurgroep en/of andere organen.
Operationeel en prestatiegericht opvolgen van het onderhoud en de support van F2w.
Toezien op het naleven van specifieke projectvoorwaarden met leveranciers en externe partners.
Toezicht houden op de uitvoering van onderhoudswerken (correctief, evolutief en adaptief) en waken over de kwaliteit van de opleveringen.
Opstellen van wekelijkse voortgangsrapporten en opvolging van sprints; optreden als beheerder en verantwoordelijke van de CAB (Change Advisory Board).
De prestaties en werkbelasting van het team opvolgen om te garanderen dat activiteiten binnen de afgesproken termijnen worden geleverd en eventuele workload- of capaciteitsproblemen tijdig signaleren.
Activiteitsgegevens analyseren (uit het Jira-tool) om wekelijkse rapporten op te maken, verbeterpunten te identificeren en corrigerende acties op te volgen.
Risico's identificeren en anticiperen, preventieve oplossingen voorstellen en toezien op hun implementatie.
Wekelijks rapporteren (vergaderingen en presentaties) aan het management over de support- en onderhoudsactiviteiten.

Profielbeschrijving

Je beschikt over een bachelor- of masterdiploma, of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
Je kan minstens 10 jaar ervaring aantonen in het beheer van complexe IT-projecten..
Je hebt een sterke affiniteit met Agile-werkmethoden (Scrum, SAFe, Kanban...) en ervaring met een iteratieve projectaanpak.
Je hebt een grondige kennis van projectmethodologieën (zoals het Agile-framework).
Je hebt een diepgaande kennis van projectmanagementtools zoals Jira (incl. scripting) of Plan.IO.
Je beschikt over sterke organisatorische en planningsvaardigheden; je behoudt het overzicht en kan prioriteiten voorstellen die door het management worden goedgekeurd.
Je communiceert duidelijk, diplomatisch en efficiënt met alle niveaus binnen een organisatie.
Je hebt een uitstekende kennis van het Frans en een goede kennis van het Nederlands en het Engels.

Wij bieden

Onze federale overheid bevindt zich midden in een digitale transformatie: van uitdagingen op het vlak van cybersecurity tot digitale communicatie, van netwerkverbeteringen om onze nieuwe manier van werken te ondersteunen tot complexe ontwikkelingsprojecten en de optimalisatie van bestaande toepassingen. Wil jij deel uitmaken van dit proces en maatschappelijke meerwaarde creëren, terwijl je werkt aan je persoonlijke ontwikkeling en je ambities waarmaakt?

Wij bieden je een contract van onbepaalde duur met een duidelijke doelstelling in een stimulerende omgeving, een zeer competitief salarispakket aangevuld met een reeks extralegale voordelen en een mobiliteitsbudget (hospitalisatieverzekering, telewerk, maaltijdcheques, mobiliteit, pensioenfonds, enz.). We hechten ook veel belang aan een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé, en onze kantoren zijn vlot bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer.

We are excited to offer a permanent opportunity for a Senior Project Manager (New Product Development)
to join our team in Severn Beach, Bristol.

In this pivotal role, you will take ownership of the development and delivery of new products, leading projects from initial planning through to successful launch and first customer deliveries. You'll play a key role in ensuring a seamless, joined-up approach across multiple functions, business units, and locations, while helping to shape and continuously improve project management practices across the organisation.

Beyond delivering projects, you'll be a role model for excellence in project management, driving best practices, developing others, and helping build a culture of continuous improvement.

Project Leadership & Delivery

Drive successful project delivery while building strong relationships and bringing teams along with you.
Proactively manage your own workload while removing obstacles for both yourself and the wider team.
Lead project meetings, ensuring clear ownership of actions, effective task management, and visibility of project status.
Identify, manage, and communicate project risks, issues, and mitigation plans.
Ensure robust project planning, realistic task estimation, and effective schedule tracking, constantly seeking opportunities to improve delivery timelines.
Manage project requirements and ensure teams remain aligned to business objectives throughout the project lifecycle.
Take ownership of project and product costs, ensuring effective financial management and control.

Stakeholder & Team Management

Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders, including those based remotely and across different business units.
Operate effectively within a matrix organisation and navigate ambiguity with confidence.
Influence and engage stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership, with the confidence to challenge where appropriate and provide realistic assessments of risks, timelines, and delivery expectations.
Develop and mentor less experienced project managers, helping others succeed and grow their capabilities.

New Product Development

Lead and manage project deliverables throughout the stage-gate product development process.
Partner with Engineering teams to track and report project progress, costs, risks, and issues at a business level.
Work closely with key stakeholders to ensure project schedules, quality standards, feature requirements, and cost targets are achieved.
Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Service, and Operations teams to ensure smooth product launches and successful transition into routine manufacturing and shipping.
Lead and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, helping to develop and implement new processes, tools, and ways of working.

Degree qualified.

Proven track record of successfully delivering product development projects within a high-tech or engineering-focused environment.
Extensive experience leading complex, multi-functional projects involving diverse stakeholder groups.
Strong understanding of stage-gate product development processes.
Experience using project management tools, issue tracking systems, and project reporting methodologies.
Broad business knowledge, including manufacturing, supply chain, procurement, quality, and service functions, and how they contribute to successful project delivery.
Ability to work flexibly across product lines, business units, and geographical locations.
Demonstrated success managing and delivering projects remotely while maintaining engagement and momentum across globally distributed teams.
Excellent communication, leadership, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.

Why Join Us?

This is an outstanding opportunity to own exciting new product developments in a cutting-edge technology environment. You'll have the chance to work with talented cross-functional teams, influence strategic business outcomes, drive continuous improvement, and play a key role in bringing innovative products to market.

Cyber Security NSW supports flexible working arrangements. This position is based in Bathurst however candidates from nearby regional centres are strongly encouraged to apply.

Manage systems to track the remediation of discovered vulnerabilities.

Maintain current knowledge of IT and security vulnerabilities and exploits.

Adapt quickly and maintain current knowledge and skills.
