Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

About The Role

As the Senior Global Operations Manager of Fulfillment & Outbound Logistics, you will own Verkada's global 3PL network and oversee inbound, warehouse, and outbound logistics operations across multiple regions. You'll be responsible for optimizing supply chain performance, managing strategic logistics partners, driving cost savings, and ensuring world-class service levels. We're looking for an experienced operations leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys solving complex supply chain challenges, and is passionate about building scalable global logistics processes.

Own and manage strategic partnerships with global 3PL providers, including vendor selection, contract negotiations, performance management, and quarterly business reviews.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve service levels across the supply chain.

Manage inventory deployment strategies, distribution network optimization, and reverse logistics (RMA/refurbishment) programs.

Establish and maintain supply chain SOPs while driving adoption of best practices across internal teams and 3PL partners.
Lead implementation and optimization of supply chain systems, including WMS, TMS, and ERP integrations.
Present operational performance, trends, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
Must be willing and able to work onsite five days per week.

8+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics, or operations management, including 5+ years managing 3PL partnerships.
Experience overseeing global logistics operations across multiple regions and international supply chains.
Strong background in warehouse, transportation, fulfillment, and distribution network management.
Experience with WMS, TMS, ERP platforms, and advanced Excel for reporting and data analysis.
Proven success driving cost reduction initiatives and improving operational efficiency through process optimization.
Experience managing vendor relationships, negotiating contracts, and holding logistics providers accountable to SLAs.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into operational improvements.
Excellent communication and project management skills with experience leading cross-functional initiatives.
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related field. APICS CSCP, Lean Six Sigma, or similar certifications are a plus.

Commuter benefits

With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. Job Description

Qualifacts is a leading provider of behavioral health software and SaaS solutions for clinical productivity, compliance and state reporting, billing, and business intelligence. Its mission is to be an innovative and trusted technology and end-to-end solutions partner, enabling exceptional outcomes for its customers and those they serve. Qualifacts’ comprehensive portfolio, including the CareLogic®, Credible™, and InSync® platforms, spans and serves the entire behavioral health, rehabilitative, and human services market supporting non-profit Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinics (CCBHC) as well as for-profit large enterprise and small business providers. Qualifacts has a loyal customer base, with more than 2,500 customers representing 75,000 providers serving more than 6 million patients. Qualifacts was recognized in the 2022 and 2023 Best in KLAS: Software and Services report as having the top ranked Behavioral Health EHR solutions.

If you want to work inside an atmosphere where innovation has purpose, and your ambition works to support our customers and those they serve, please apply today!

We are seeking candidates in Nashville or Tampa to work a hybrid schedule in either office location. Remote candidates will not be considered.

Summary Of The Project Manager

The Project Manager will be applying company policies and procedures to resolve a variety of issues. They will determine a course of action based on guidelines and modify processes and methods as required. They should have a basic knowledge of task management and project management concepts to apply this knowledge and basic problem-solving techniques to define and resolve problems. They will determine a course of action based on guidelines.

Responsibilities For The Project Manager

Manages full implementation project life cycle from kick-off preparation through implementation completion and transition to support for small to mid-range projects
Manages customer relationships and expectations through regular touchpoints, distribution of status briefings and onsite meetings
Interfaces with customer staff across levels and departments throughout project lifecycle
Influences customer attitudes, behaviors, and intentions throughout every phase of the implementation process, ensuring alignment, adoption, and long-term success
Ensures that all projects are executed properly maintaining customer satisfaction, along with attaining desired outcomes in cost, quality and delivery timeframes
Tracks project timelines updating the team with status reports in order to meet and exceed projected metrics
Works with management to determine resource management, project plans, and risk assessment in order to keep the customers on target
Works closely with cross-functional teams to resolve project issues in order to optimize results while minimizing project costs
Partners with diverse departments such as Sales, Product, Sate reporting, and RCMS to drive alignment, streamline workflows, and achieve shared project goals
Builds productive internal/external working relationships to resolve mutual problems by collaborating on procedures or transactions
Focuses on providing standard professional advice and creates initial reports/analyzes for review by experienced team professionals
Focuses on providing standard project guidance based on platform implementation methodologies and creates initial reports/analyzes for review by management

Qualifications Of The Project Manager

Bachelor’s degree (additional equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of degree)
5 years’ experience in project management or a related role; behavioral health experience preferred
PMP preferred

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Of The Project Manager

Ability to manage multiple customer projects working with differing timelines
Strong communication skills, both written and spoken
Expertise in organization and multitasking
Able to juggle multiple projects at once with little to no direction
Use a consultative approach with clients and adapt communication style to the audience
Ability to travel 25% of the time

Qualifacts is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Minimum 3-5 years of project management experience, preferably in corporate real estate, facilities management, technology deployment, or startup environments

Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and master new technologies, systems, and processes with minimal supervision

Join AIR6500 and lead the delivery of complex Defence capability where systems integration, stakeholder leadership and delivery excellence matter.

We are seeking an experienced Program Delivery Manager to play a key leadership role within AIR6500, delivering complex, large-scale Defence systems integration capability.
This is a senior delivery role for an accomplished Program Manager, Senior Project Manager or experienced delivery leader with a proven track record delivering complex hardware and software platforms across major Defence programs. Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

Job Description
:

As a Project Manager in this role, you will oversee the transition of a medium-sized IT system to a new program, ensuring seamless migration and minimal disruption to ongoing operations. You will coordinate the modernization and transformation of infrastructure that includes Windows and Linux servers, Kubernetes clusters, storage appliances, desktops, and their associated management software.

Your responsibilities will involve developing detailed project plans, managing timelines, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver results within scope and budget. You will also be tasked with identifying potential risks, implementing mitigation strategies, and maintaining clear communication with stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

To excel in this position, familiarity with IT Service Management frameworks and Agile project management methodologies will be highly advantageous. Experience with system migrations, particularly involving hybrid environments of both Windows and Linux, will help you navigate the complexities of the transition. Exposure to container orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes, as well as hands-on knowledge of storage solutions and endpoint management tools, will enable you to address technical challenges effectively. A background in leading IT modernization or transformation initiatives, especially those requiring coordination across multiple technology domains, will further support your success in this dynamic environment.

The work you'll do
:

Lead and manage the transition of a medium-sized IT system to a new program, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
Oversee all aspects of IT modernization and transformation initiatives, including planning, execution, and delivery.
Coordinate and manage resources across Windows and Linux servers, Kubernetes clusters, storage appliances, desktops, and associated management software.
Implement and maintain IT Service Management best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
Apply Agile Project Management methodologies to ensure timely and efficient project delivery.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and vendors to ensure project objectives are met.
Monitor project progress, identify risks, and develop mitigation strategies.
Communicate project status, milestones, and deliverables to stakeholders and leadership.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies, security standards, and industry best practices.
Drive continuous improvement and innovation throughout the IT transition process.

:

10+ years of experience managing infrastructure initiatives.
Experience in the following areas:
Agile Scrum Project Management

Technology Strategy Planning

Infrastructure Modernization

About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Peraton is seeking a Cyber Threat Analyst in our Linthicum, MD office in support of our Department of Defense (DoD) customer as part of a highly talented, highly motivated, and high-performing team. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of cyber investigations, digital forensics, cyber threat analysis, and mission support in a dynamic and collaborative environment. The successful candidate will contribute to protecting national security interests by leveraging technical expertise, analytical skills, and innovative problem-solving to address complex cyber challenges. Individuals who are passionate about cybersecurity, committed to excellence, and eager to make a meaningful impact are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities:

Cyber Threat Analysis: Analyze and interpret cyber threat intelligence with a focus on threats impacting the Defense Industrial Base (DIB). Identify potential risks and vulnerabilities affecting defense contractors and their supply chains.
Reporting: Prepare detailed reports and briefings on cyber incidents, threat analysis, and investigative findings with particular emphasis on impacts to the DIB. Communicate findings and recommendations to senior officials and stakeholders.
Incident Response: Triage, analysis and support incident response activities related to cybersecurity incidents affecting the DIB, including detection, analysis, and mitigation of breaches or attacks.
Collaboration: Work closely with DIB and interagency partners to share information and coordinate response efforts. Facilitate communication and support to defense contractors as needed.
Tool Utilization: Use cybersecurity tools and technologies to conduct fusion analysis; performs queries, pivots on indicators, and research malware characteristics (Message-Digest Algorithm 5 (MD5), Secure Hash Algorithm 1 (SHA1), file size, file name, file paths, etc.). May leverage tools such as Analyst1, Kibana, Virus Total, Recorded Future, etc.
Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the development and enhancement of cyber investigation methodologies, tools, and processes, with a particular focus on improving security within the DIB.

Qualifications

Clearance requirement: Active/current Secret (TS/SCI preferred).
Education: Associates degree and 7+ years of experience; OR Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of experience; OR Master's Degree and 3+ years of experience. Or 0 years with PhD. However, four (4) years of additional relevant experience or specialized training will be considered in lieu of a Bachelor's degree. Relevant certifications (e.g., CYSA+, CISSP, CEH, CISM) are preferred.
Experience: Experience in cybersecurity analysis, incident response, or digital forensics. Requires a detailed knowledge of Department of Defense and service level (Army, Navy, Air Force) intelligence communities, including collection methods, production resources, and responsibilities. Knowledge of advanced persistent threats (APTs), Tactics Techniques and Procedures (TTPs)
Technical Skills: Proficiency in cybersecurity tools and technologies (e.g., Virus Total, Domain Tools, SIEM, IDS/IPS, forensic analysis tools). Knowledge of operating systems, network protocols, cyber threat actors, cyber kill chain, Indicator of Compromises (IOCs) and MITRE ATT&CK framework
Analytical Skills: Requires skills and abilities in supervising the handling classified information. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and provide actionable insights.
Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information and threat impacts to non-technical audiences and stakeholders. Requires prior experience briefing information to decision-makers and leaders. Uses Jira to track analysis tasks and communicate status.
Team Player: Ability to work effectively in a team environment and collaborate with various stakeholders, including those in the DIB. Provides mentorship to less-senior analysts.

Details

Target Salary Range: $86,000 - $138,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Document current and future state processes using workflows, process maps, swim lane diagrams, wireframes, mockups, presentations, and AS IS / TO BE documentation.

Coordinate and facilitate User Acceptance Testing and assist stakeholders through the testing and implementation process.

Validate that completed Salesforce solutions address the original business requirements and expected outcomes.

Manage multiple concurrent initiatives while balancing priorities, deadlines, and stakeholder expectations.

Build strong relationships across business, IT, vendor, and leadership teams.

Experience translating business requirements into Salesforce functionality and solutions.

Experience working with ERP systems and multiple enterprise data sources.

new_jobs.description:
In the journey of life, your career should make a difference.

At Inizio Evoke, we come together—to do the best work, in the best possible place. We're all in. Because it's everyone's role to make health more human™.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Program Manager to run the operating rhythm of Operatev — Inizio Evoke's enterprise AI platform — from the inside out.

This is a high-visibility, cross-functional role responsible for keeping the program on schedule and its status transparent. You'll own the connective tissue: sequencing work across Product, Development, Change & Enablement, Support, Operations, Business Transformation, and Commercialization so that nothing blocks on an unowned handoff and everyone is working from the same picture of where things stand.

You will sit at the center of a program that is building and rolling out a platform to 1,200 people. That means competing priorities, real dependencies, and a delivery pace that doesn't slow down. You will bring strong program management fundamentals in a product development environment, thrive on clarity and structure, and know how to translate complex cross-functional realities into reporting that actually drives decisions.

This is a remote role reporting to the Program Lead.

What You'll Do:

Own Cross-Team Sequencing

Map dependencies across functions — what depends on what, in what order — and monitor progress against that sequence
Ensure handoffs are owned, surface unresolved blockers early, and drive items to closure or escalation
Maintain visibility into the implications of sequencing decisions for Product, Development, and all downstream functions

Run the Quarterly Planning Cycle

Gather functional inputs across all workstreams
Facilitate commitment-setting and document outcomes
Translate quarterly commitments into trackable milestones and hold functions accountable to them

Track Program Resourcing

Maintain visibility into where capacity is going against what's committed and manage the program's calendar to proactively address capacity challenges
Surface trends and anomalies to program leadership before they become problems
Oversee recruitment process, meeting with talent acquisition for updates and ensuring timely progress through stakeholder participation

Set and Hold Stage Gate Standards

Define the gates work passes through and what evidence clears each one
Keep functional cadences in sync without taking over internal functional processes (sprint practices, capability lifecycle, etc.)

Run Delivery Forums

Facilitate the weekly initiative update and risk review
Maintain the risk register and drive items to resolution or escalation
Track progress against quarterly commitments and hold the reporting cadence

Define Reporting Standards

Establish and maintain the data taxonomy that governs how each function reports its metrics
Ensure functional outputs roll into one consistent program-level picture rather than competing narratives

Own Executive Reporting

Prepare and deliver the synthesized program view for executive and steering committee audiences
Surface where delivery reality constrains what's being asked — clearly and with context

What You'll Bring:

7+ years of experience in program management, delivery management, or PMO leadership — ideally within a technology platform, transformation, or product delivery context
Experience running formal planning cycles (quarterly or release-based) and translating outputs into trackable commitments
Track record of building and maintaining executive-level reporting that is trusted and acted on
Comfortable managing budget and resource visibility — not ownership, but accurate tracking and surfacing of variance
Background in professional services, agency, consulting, or regulated industry preferred (healthcare, life sciences, or similar)

Skills

Strong program and project management fundamentals — dependency mapping, risk management, stage gates, and cadence management
Highly organized: you make things visible, structured, and easy to act on
Strong written and verbal communication; able to translate complexity into clean reporting without losing accuracy
Comfortable operating in agile/iterative environments where priorities shift and the plan evolves
Skilled facilitator — able to run productive cross-functional forums without letting them drift

Mindset

You keep things moving without needing to own everything
You surface problems early and bring them forward with enough context for a decision
You enforce standards consistently — not rigidly, but reliably
You understand the difference between tracking and deciding, and you stay in your lane while making it easy for others to stay in theirs

What We Offer

A central, high-impact role in a program building something genuinely new — an enterprise AI platform designed to change how a 1,200-person agency does its work
Direct visibility to executive and steering committee leadership
A cross-functional operating environment where your work touches every part of the program
The opportunity to define and own the operating standards that the program runs on

Inizio Evoke provides an exciting and flexible work environment, great compensation packages and outstanding company paid benefits including medical, dental, 401(k), tuition reimbursement and flexible time off.

Facilitate stakeholder collaboration across business and technology teams.

Ongoing support and the removal of barriers between stakeholders and Project Teams.
Periodic reporting of Project Team performance through well-defined Key Performance Indicators (e.g. burn-down / burn-up charts, velocity, etc.), value generation, and taking into consideration feedback from the Project Team, Business Owner, and key stakeholders.

Certified Scrum Master or Professional Scrum Master certification.

Extensive experience in leading business and systems delivery teams using Project Management and Agile methodologies.
In-depth knowledge of Project Management and Agile frameworks, principles, and processes
Strong coaching and leadership skills.
Team focused with ability to teach teams how to be self-organized.
Adaptable to change and comfortable with transparency, inspection, and adaption.
Comfortable working with multiple teams.

Ability to work with cross divisional teams, senior management, and internal and external stakeholders.

new_jobs.title: AI GTM Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization
.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire
customer journey.

We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi
— so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

Bloomreach
builds agentic AI systems for our customers. We also run them ourselves.

Our AI SDR program books sales meetings with AI - inbound and outbound, across four regions, in multiple languages. The program needs an owner: someone who sets its direction, drives its results, and proves its ROI. This is a program leadership role, not an engineering one. Two dedicated AI ops experts build and run the platform. You decide what it does, why, and for whom. You should understand AI agents well enough to direct the people building them - your leverage is judgment, but being tech savvy is a must.

The team experiments by default: we test new AI tools, run scoped POCs, and keep what works. You'll own the program, its direction, its results, its pipeline number.

What You'll Own

The AI SDR program, end to end. Inbound and outbound, AMER + EMEA + APAC. Who gets enrolled, what the agents say, when a human takes over, and what it produces in pipeline. You set direction; the platform ops managers make it run. (Inbound request ops and routing sit with a colleague.)
Pipeline as your number, ROI as your story. Meetings booked → accepted → qualified pipeline created. Cost per meeting, cost per pipeline dollar. You report the program's return to leadership, with numbers that hold up under questioning.
The human SDR side. SDRs are the other half of the program - and where it most often breaks: lead quality disputes, unclear prioritization, follow-up that dies after one touch, handovers that lose context. You'll sit with the SDR teams and their leaders, find root causes, and fix them - with an AI assist, a process change, or a better definition.
The human–agent split. What agents do, what humans do, and where the handover sits. You own that line and move it based on evidence.
Signal-driven enrollment. Targeting runs on manual batches today. You'll drive the move to continuous enrollment based on account scoring, intent signals, and engagement decay. You define the logic; the ops team builds it.
The buying experience. Outreach should arrive because an account signalled something, say something true about the buyer's business, and make the next step obvious.
Program reporting. Volume, coverage, results, and ROI on a live dashboard, generated automatically. Parts still run on exports. Fix that early.
What comes next. The AI SDR pattern - signal in, agent acts, human closes - applies beyond outbound: event follow-up, hand-raiser nurture, re-engagement. Once the core program runs well, you'll make the case for the next one and drive its launch.

What success looks like after 3 months

Outbound volume and coverage are consistent across regions. Nobody asks "why did outbound drop last week?"
Leadership references your ROI model in planning: cost per meeting, cost per pipeline dollar, trend.
The top three SDR pain points from your first quarter are root-caused and fixed - and SDR leaders would confirm it unprompted.
Meeting acceptance is high. Rejections have known causes, not theories.
Reporting is fully automated. Your time goes into decisions.
The program activities and volume is connected to human activities, pipeline number for ICP accounts is bigger - and you can show which changes drove it.
At least one new agentic program is live and producing pipeline.

What you'll bring

You've run programs with a number attached. Demand gen, SDR/BDR, growth, or GTM programs where you owned the outcome and defended the metric.
You've operated AI workflows in production. You've deployed, directed, or owned automations other people depended on. You can set requirements, challenge the build, and tell when the agent is the problem versus the data. You don't need to write code - you do need to never be bluffed by it.
ROI fluency. You can build a cost-per-outcome model and explain it. You'd rather show a live dashboard than a slide.
You diagnose team problems at the source. "The leads are bad" is where your investigation starts, not where it ends. You've worked with frontline teams, found the real constraint, and fixed it.
SDRs, AEs, and their leaders are your users. When the program misfires, you’ll be their point of contact.
The buyer's point of view. Buyers don't care that outreach was efficient - only that it was worth their time. You'll kill a volume that doesn't clear that bar.
Enough technical depth to be dangerous. You can read a workflow, question a data model, and learn a new tool in a week. Experience with our stack is welcome, not required.
Global comfort. Four regions, several languages, overlap with US hours.

Big Advantage:: hands-on LLM tooling beyond vendor UIs (Claude Code, MCP, custom agents); time in or working with SDR/BDR and demand gen function in B2B SaaS.

The stack you'll drive

Salesforce

Qualified
Salesloft
UserGems
Claude - plus a mandate to evaluate AI-native tooling with a clear bar for measurable impact.

The team

You'll join Marketing Operations six people who operationalize and automate everything in marketing. Two of them work full-time on the AI SDR platform: they build and run it; you set its direction and co-own it: reporting and attribution, co-own and maintain inbound/outbound processes and find new tools. It's a team that builds its own tools rather than filing tickets for them.

More things you'll like about Bloomreach:

Culture:

A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one.
We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.
We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.
We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.
We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.
We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*.
The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5

Personal Development:

We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions.
Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.*
Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins.
Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)*

Well-being:

The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.*
Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.*
We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones.
We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other.
Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.*

Compensation:

Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.*
Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.*
We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000!
We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!*

(*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.)

Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences!

If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful!

Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees.

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Energy Storage & Distribution System Software
new_jobs.description:
Imagine a piloted air taxi that takes off vertically, then quietly carries you and your fellow passengers over the congested city streets below, enabling you to spend more time with the people and places that matter most. At Joby, we've been working to make that dream a reality since 2009 and we're now in the final stages of certifying our aircraft with the FAA. With plans to launch our aircraft in the US and Dubai, we're now scaling manufacturing and preparing for the launch of our commercial service.

Overview

Joby’s Battery System serves as the core of our electric aircraft, encompassing the battery packs, the safety-critical Battery Management System (BMS) software, and the high-performance Ground Charging Equipment designed for rapid turnaround. This integrated ecosystem is meticulously engineered to support the demands of commercial eVTOL operations.

As a member of the technical program management team, you will lead the Battery System software domain, overseeing embedded C++ development for the BMS and Ground Charging System, along with model-based control algorithms. You will be responsible for facilitating design and driving execution through Scrum methodologies, managing DO-178C certification activities, and steering software through the release process for flight. In close partnership with the hardware and electrical PMs, you will manage the comprehensive Battery System technical roadmap, ensuring alignment on timelines, dependencies, and delivery milestones.

The position will be based at our San Carlos location with occasional travel to Marina and Santa Cruz sites as needed.

Responsibilities

Single point of accountability for Battery System software program execution across two development methodologies — embedded C++ and model-based design — on independent sprint cadences
Facilitate design without doing the design: translating architecture discussions into well-scoped workstreams, making dependencies and critical paths explicit, and driving risks and recovery plans to closure
Run scrum for the BMS flight software and Ground Charging software teams — sprint planning, execution, and summaries — across their independent cadences
Facilitate the model-based design lifecycle: requirements flow-down, sprint execution, characterization testing, and formal hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) verification, including rig scheduling, requirement coverage traceability, and failure disposition
Own the MBD-to-C++ release chain from development complete through characterization testing, HIL verification, documentation, and release evidence
Program-manage the DO-178C certification effort with our certification partner, software verification team, and FAA software designee, including high-level/low-level requirement traceability
Maintain an integrated program schedule, and partner with the Battery System hardware/electrical program manager on the overall Battery System roadmap, timeline, and cross-team dependencies
Coordinate on-time delivery into system-level integration and test environments for integrated testing and aircraft safe-for-flight release, including powertrain plant models for HIL verification
Coordinate flight software release with the broader Joby software organization, and Ground Charging software integration with fleet infrastructure and fielded equipment
Run the program's operating cadence: program reviews, key metrics (technical, schedule, risk), and concise status reporting to leadership
Identify, advocate for, and manage the development of test assets for software prototyping and verification

Required

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 5+ years of relevant experience
5+ years of technical program management for embedded software or integrated hardware/software development, managing requirements, priorities, scope, and schedule
Experience performing the Scrum master role for embedded or firmware teams, including managing multiple workstreams on different sprint cadences
Experience delivering software under a formal safety-critical process (DO-178C preferred; ISO 26262 / ASIL D functional safety is a strong equivalent)
Deep familiarity with the embedded software development lifecycle (C++, real-time targets), with the ability to make engineering-informed program decisions
Strong track record of managing complex cross-functional programs and dependencies across teams you don't directly control
Experience with Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar tools, as well as requirements management tools (e.g., Jama, DOORS, Polarion)
Clear, well-structured, and concise communication tailored to each audience, from engineers to executives
Ability to manage a cross-functional team, including interfaces with hardware design and test teams, through an iterative design process

Desired

Familiarity with DO-178C program execution, including DO-331 (model-based development) and DO-330 (tool qualification)
Familiarity with model-based design workflows (MATLAB/Simulink) and the model-to-code handoff
Familiarity with HIL test platforms (e.g., dSPACE, NI, Speedgoat)
Familiarity with battery systems, BMS, high voltage systems, or EV charging / EVSE
Familiarity with FAA or EASA certification programs (ARP4754A)
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
Experience thriving in a fast-paced, quick-iteration hardware environment

Additional Information

Compensation at Joby is a combination of base pay and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). The target base pay for this position is $118,700 - $192,800/yr.The compensation package will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Joby also offers a comprehensive benefits package, including paid time off, healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan with a company match, an employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, and more.

Joby is an Equal Opportunity Employer

new_jobs.description:
Description

Are you excited by the opportunity to drive programs that put robots into the real world, coordinating across software, research, and hardware teams to ship systems that move, plan, and adapt at fleet scale? Are you energized by the challenge of turning leading research into production-ready capabilities?

At Amazon Robotics, we're building the future of mobile robotic systems. Our robots don't just follow lines on a floor. They navigate dynamic environments, coordinate with each other, and make decisions in real time. Technical Program Managers here don't sit on the sidelines. You'll be in the middle of it, connecting applied scientists, research scientists, software engineers, and program teams to deliver things that haven't been done before.

The problems we solve are hard. Requirements shift as research matures. Timelines compress as business needs grow. There's ambiguity everywhere, and that's the point. We're looking for someone who sees that ambiguity as the job, not as an obstacle to it. Someone who can build structure without slowing teams down, and drive alignment without waiting for permission.

Come build what's next in robotics.

Key job responsibilities

Work cross functionally with other TPMs, program teams, SW teams, applied scientists, and research to align on priorities, dependencies, and delivery timelines
Own end to end program execution for complex, multi-team initiatives spanning software, ML/research, and systems integration
Translate ambiguous research objectives into structured plans with clear milestones, owners, and exit criteria
Identify risks and dependencies early, escalate with data, and drive resolution
Build and maintain mechanisms (reviews, dashboards, status cadences) that give leadership visibility without creating drag on teams
Coordinate across orgs to unblock teams, resolve competing priorities, and negotiate tradeoffs
Drive multi-quarter roadmap planning in partnership with engineering and science leadership
Manage a cross functional process to translate customer and business needs into a sequenced product roadmap and releases
Show ownership and leadership in coordinating projects across multiple teams, driving them to successful conclusion while building strong relationships with internal partners

A day in the life

Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage

401(k) Plan

7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

new_jobs.title: Principal, Technical Program Manager, Secure Connection Services (SCS), Tactical Edge Mission Engineering Group (TEMEG)
new_jobs.description:
Description

Shape the future of secure communications for the world's most critical missions. As a Principal Technical Program Manager for SCS TEMEG, you'll define the strategy and lead customers and cross-functional teams to solve problems of high ambiguity and high impact.

Secure Connections Services (SCS), Tactical Edge Mission Engineering Group (TEMEG) designs, develops, and delivers emerging edge capabilities to enable the use of AWS services.

You own the strategic roadmap and drive cross-organizational alignment on priorities and delivery. You leverage deep technical expertise and executive-level stakeholder management to deliver solutions from concept through customer adoption. You bring proven experience architecting large-scale distributed systems and apply that expertise to commercial and government customers. You are data- and metric-driven, and relentlessly focused on performance in resource-constrained environments.

Solve challenging problems that will revolutionize satellite connectivity in the cloud
Work for a recognized leader in supporting space customers with cloud computing
Have direct impact on hundreds, possibly thousands, of users of the AWS secure connections ecosystem.

If you're driven to lead at the intersection of security innovation and mission-critical impact, this is the role for you.

If Arlington, VA (Arlington HQ2)

This role will sit in our new headquarters in Northern Virginia, where Amazon will invest $2.5 billion dollars, occupy 4 million square feet of energy efficient office space, and create at least 25,000 new full-time jobs. Our employees and the neighboring community will also benefit from the associated investments from the Commonwealth including infrastructure updates, public transportation improvements, and new access to Reagan National Airport.

By working together on behalf of our customers, we are building the future one innovative product, service, and idea at a time. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This position requires that the candidate selected must be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities

In This Role You Will

Serve as the primary executive interface with customers, translating mission-critical requirements into product roadmap priorities for engineering teams
Drive cross-organizational alignment across product, engineering, sales, and partner teams to deliver integrated solutions
Work across the product, program, engineering, hardware, software, and infrastructure teams to manage requirements, scope, and delivery of worldwide AWS security features and services
Assess risks, anticipate issues, overcome technical obstacles, and make difficult trade-off decisions while managing cost and schedule to drive adoption goals and meet our customer commitments.

Successful candidates will have a strong technical background, be detail oriented, and have excellent problem-solving abilities. You will represent program status to senior leadership. Your program management expertise and operational excellence will influence teams’ decisions and drive secure and scalable solutions. You should be passionate about delivering great customer experiences and changing the way customers leverage AWS services.

Builders at Amazon work on real world problems on a global scale, own their systems end-to-end, and influence the direction of our technology that impacts hundreds of millions customers around the world. Join a team of super smart, customer obsessed builders that think big and have fun.

A day in the life

In this role, you will own the planning and execution of a new service managing cross-team and cross-org development and delivery, participating in architecture decisions, design reviews, and represent our service to Senior and Executive leadership. You will work with software developers and networking engineers along with product managers and other oranizations to deliver new services and new features create the best in class solutions for our customers worldwide!

Candidates must be comfortable with ambiguity and eager to embrace ownership and accountability.

About The Team

About AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Why AWS?

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
5+ years of software development experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
7+ years of professional or military experience
Current, active US Government Security Clearance of Top Secret with SCI eligibility or above

Preferred Qualifications

12+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
Experience in security of web services, video content protection technologies, cryptography, network security protocols and operating system security
Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
Experience with network, system, or software architecture
Experience communicating technical details verbally and in writing
Experience influencing innovation through a partner ecosystem with either solutions or programs that have demonstrated success at enterprise customers
Current, active US Government Security Clearance of TS/SCI with Polygraph

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

new_jobs.title: Business Operations Manager - Fitness/Gym
new_jobs.description:
A growing fitness and wellness organization is seeking a highly adaptable Business Operations Manager to play a key role in supporting the next stage of its growth. This is an opportunity to step into a newly created position with broad visibility across a multi-location business and help build the systems, structure, and operational discipline needed to scale successfully. Working closely with senior leadership and gym operations teams, you will become a central resource across the organization, helping connect people, systems, reporting, administration, and day-to-day execution.

The role is intentionally broad. You may be reviewing KPIs and identifying operational gaps one day, supporting payroll or systems administration the next, then helping prepare a new location for opening. The common thread is ownership. You will be trusted to understand how the business works, identify what needs attention, and help create practical solutions that make the organization stronger and more efficient. This role will appeal to someone who enjoys variety, thrives in an entrepreneurial environment, and sees opportunity in building better ways of working. As the organization continues to expand, you will have the chance to shape the role, influence how the business operates, and become an important part of the infrastructure supporting its future growth.

Description

Manage and support key administrative and operational systems across multiple corporate gym locations.
Take ownership of responsibilities currently managed by senior leadership, helping create scalable processes as the organization grows.
Monitor, maintain, and audit business systems to ensure information is accurate, current, and being used consistently.
Review operational reporting and KPIs, identifying discrepancies, trends, and areas requiring follow-up.
Work closely with Gym Managers, General Managers, Assistant General Managers, and senior operations leadership.
Review membership billing issues and help ensure errors or discrepancies are identified and resolved.
Monitor cash deposits and financial transactions to ensure appropriate reporting and accountability.
Support payment administration for employees, contractors, personal trainers, vendors, and other business partners.
Ensure employee information and new hires are properly entered and maintained within HR and payroll systems.
Provide administrative support related to HR, payroll, onboarding, and employee records.
Assist with system access, password resets, troubleshooting, and day-to-day technology-related issues.
Support the administration of security, IT, email, and other business platforms used across the organization.
Assist with website updates and other corporate administrative projects as required.
Support new gym openings, including systems setup, administration, onboarding, and operational readiness.
Travel between corporate locations when required to support operations, projects, or new openings.
Identify opportunities to improve processes, simplify workflows, and create greater consistency across locations.
Take on additional operational and administrative responsibilities as the needs of the business continue to evolve.

Requirements

Strong experience in business administration, operations, systems administration, office management, or a similar multi-functional role.
Highly computer literate with the ability to quickly learn and work across multiple software platforms.
Strong systems mindset with excellent attention to detail and an ability to identify errors or inconsistencies.
Comfortable working with reports, KPIs, billing information, payroll-related administration, and basic financial controls.
Strong problem-solving skills and the confidence to investigate issues and determine practical solutions.
Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities across several locations.
Adaptable and comfortable working in a growing, entrepreneurial environment where priorities may change quickly.
Willingness to take ownership and step outside traditional role boundaries when needed.
Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with senior leadership and operational teams.
Experience working within a startup, scale-up, multi-location, franchise, hospitality, retail, or service-based organization would be an asset.
Experience with GymMaster or similar membership-management software would be an advantage.
Experience with Microsoft 365, HRIS/payroll platforms, payment systems, or similar business applications is beneficial.
Fitness industry experience is not required.
Ability to travel periodically between locations and support future openings.

Corporate Culture

Base salary of $85,000 to $105,000, based on experience.
Potential performance-based bonus as the position and incentive structure develop.
Comprehensive healthcare benefits.
Employer RSP matching program.
Regional gym membership.
Hybrid work potential once onboarding and training are complete, with an expected balance of approximately three days per week in the office.
Exposure to senior leadership and multiple areas of the business.
Opportunity to shape a newly created role and establish systems and processes that will support future growth.
A highly varied position within an entrepreneurial organization where initiative, flexibility, and problem-solving are valued.

Contact Michelle Doucette at 604.734.5584 x3 or submit your resume in confidence below.

new_jobs.title: Digital Product Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Description

Evolus (NASDAQ: EOLS) is a performance beauty company with a customer-centric approach focused on delivering breakthrough products. We are seeking an experienced and driven Digital Product Business Analyst to join our Digital Team, reporting to the Director, Product Management. The Business Analyst partners with Product Management to translate business needs into detailed requirements while supporting planning, delivery, and execution across Evolus' U.S. digital product portfolio.
If you join our team, you will be working on some of the most exciting opportunities and challenges we face, with a team that values growth, recognition, and camaraderie. If you are looking for an opportunity to exhibit your knowledge and technical abilities in a unique environment, then look no further! In this role, you will be challenged to drive the success of Evolus in an effort to build a brand like no other
Essential duties and responsibilities where you'll make the biggest impact…

Gather and document business requirements.
Translate business needs into user stories and functional requirements.
Manage product documentation and backlog administration.
Coordinate testing, releases, and implementation activities.
Partner across Commercial, Marketing, Customer Experience, Medical Affairs and Engineering.
Support roadmap planning and portfolio governance.
Track product performance and operational metrics.
Identify opportunities to improve product processes and operations.
Office Location - Newport Beach (hybrid onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday)
Other duties as assigned

Qualifications And Skills You’ll Bring To The Team…

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Marketing, Product Management, a related field, or equivalent work experience.
4+ years of experience in business analysis, digital product management, product operations, or a related role.
Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business and functional requirements for digital products.
Experience working within Agile/Scrum product development environments and supporting product backlogs, sprint planning, and release activities.
Demonstrated experience partnering with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate business needs into actionable product requirements.
Experience supporting digital product launches, enhancements, testing, implementation, and ongoing optimization.
Experience using data and operational metrics to evaluate product performance and identify improvement opportunities.
Communication: Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and documentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to business audiences and business needs to technical teams.
Organization: Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple products, initiatives, stakeholders, dependencies, and deadlines simultaneously.
Cross-functional collaboration: Strong ability to work across Commercial, Marketing, Customer Experience, Medical Affairs, Engineering, and other business functions.

Preferred Qualifications…

Experience in healthcare, aesthetics, pharmaceutical, medical device, consumer technology, or another regulated industry is preferred.
Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Product board, Aha!, Figma, Miro/Lucid chart, Salesforce, Google Analytics/Adobe Analytics, Power BI/Tableau, or similar platforms would be valuable.

Compensation & Total Rewards

This is an Exempt position. The expected pay range for this position is $81,000 to $101,000. Your actual base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on a number of considerations, including but not limited to role-relevant knowledge and skills, experience, education, geographic location, certifications, and more.
We offer more than just a paycheck, and your base salary is just the start! Stay happy and healthy with our competitive suite of medical, dental, and vision benefits to help you feel your best and be your best. We also provide those benefits you shouldn’t have to worry about, from employer-covered life insurance to short-term disability. Take advantage of the 401k match offered by Evolus and let us invest in your future. You may also be eligible for new hire equity and long-term incentives in the form of RSUs, stock options, and/or discretionary bonuses. We offer mental health and wellbeing resources for you to develop skills to find your calm, boost your confidence, and show up as your best self in work and life. Travel or relax and come back feeling refreshed with our flexible paid time off program for exempt employees and a paid time off accrual plan for non-exempt employees. Did we mention the holiday soft closure between the Christmas and New Years holidays? We have that, too. Additional perks include regularly catered team meals at our Evolus Headquarters, a fully stocked kitchen (Kombucha & Coffee included), and the opportunity to join an organization where our values of Grit, Impact, Fun, and Transparency are displayed daily.
Evolus takes pride in being a company on the forefront of innovation, while being committed to conducting its business with the highest degrees of integrity, professionalism, and social responsibility. Global Future Leaders Program: Start Strong. Lead Early.

The Lenovo Global Future Leaders Program is a highly selective program designed to develop Lenovo's next generation of business and technology leaders. Created for exceptional graduates, the program provides accelerated development opportunities for individuals ready to grow their careers and make an impact at one of the world's leading technology companies.

As a Global Future Leader, you'll gain hands-on experience through challenging assignments and rotational opportunities across Lenovo. You'll collaborate with teams and leaders around the world, building a broad understanding of our organization while developing the skills needed to create meaningful impact. During your first three years, you'll participate in cross-functional experiences, strategic projects, leadership development, and mentorship opportunities designed to accelerate your growth. From day one, you'll take on meaningful work, gain exposure to senior leaders, and help drive innovative solutions that deliver smarter technology for all. We're looking for ambitious problem-solvers, innovative thinkers, and future leaders who are energized by technology, embrace new challenges, and are eager to make an impact.

What You Can Expect

Cross-functional rotational experiences across Lenovo's business, providing broad exposure and diverse career experiences
Meaningful business impact from day one through strategic projects and real-world challenges
Exposure to senior leaders along with structured leadership development and mentorship
Collaboration with global teams and stakeholders across one of the world's leading technology companies
Accelerated career growth through innovation, continuous learning, and opportunities to influence the future of smarter technology for all

In This Global Future Leader role, you will act as a Strategy Analyst

Role Overview

In this role, you will support the development and execution of Motorola’s overall business strategy as well as focused strategic initiatives across areas such as regional expansion, cost savings, investment optimization, and business growth. You will analyze market and business trends, translate data into actionable insights, and coordinate strategic initiatives across cross-functional and regional teams. This role is designed for an early-career professional who is analytical, detail-oriented, and organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and build effective partnerships across a global organization.

What You’ll Do

Strategic Initiative Support: Contribute to strategic initiatives across Motorola’s key business priorities and geographies by coordinating inputs, tracking progress, and preparing analyses.
Market Business Analysis: Analyze market trends, business performance, consumer insights, and changes in the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and inform strategic recommendations.
Competitive Market Intelligence: Develop competitive analyses, market intelligence summaries, and clear, data-supported insights for business and marketing stakeholders.
Investment Spend Optimization: Support efforts to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of Motorola’s investments and business spend.
Executive Reporting Communication: Create clear presentations, reports, and communication materials for the global business, strategy organization, and leadership audiences.
Business Case Development: Assist in building business cases for new initiatives by defining assumptions, expected outcomes, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
Cross-Functional Strategy Execution: Collaborate with cross-functional teams and regional partners to support alignment and execution of Motorola’s strategic business priorities.

What You’ll Learn

How global business strategies are developed, evaluated, and executed across Motorola’s strategic priorities and geographic markets.
How to analyze market trends, business performance, consumer insights, and competitive intelligence to identify opportunities and inform strategic decisions.
How to translate complex business and market data into clear, actionable recommendations for business and leadership stakeholders.
How to develop business cases, define assumptions, establish KPIs, and evaluate the potential impact of new strategic initiatives.
How global strategy, marketing, regional, and cross-functional teams collaborate to execute business priorities within the technology and consumer electronics industry.

Job Requirements: Must Have

Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field, with Finance, Marketing, or Strategy concentrations preferred.
Relevant experience in business strategy, data analytics, research, consulting, or a related field.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Analytical Problem-Solving Skills: Demonstrated ability to analyze data, structure business problems, and translate findings into clear insights and recommendations.
Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly present business insights and strategic recommendations.
Organization Collaboration: Detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities while working effectively in a collaborative, global environment.
Ownership Curiosity: Self-motivated, curious, and comfortable taking ownership of assigned work while adapting to new challenges.

Nice to Have

Advanced degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, Economics, or a related field.
Experience in the smartphone, technology, or consumer electronics industry.
Experience supporting strategy, marketing analytics, consulting, or cross-functional business initiatives.
Familiarity with market research, competitive intelligence, business case development, or KPI reporting.
Excellent problem-solving skills and a strong interest in technology and business strategy.
Strong communication and collaboration abilities across different teams and stakeholders.
Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.
