new_jobs.description:
About This Position

Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX) served approximately 52 million passengers in 2025, making it one of the busiest airports in the nation and a major commercial aviation hub for the country's fifth largest city. PHX is the largest of three airports in the Phoenix Airport System along with Deer Valley and Goodyear operated by the City of Phoenix Aviation Department (AVN). Collectively, these airports generate an estimated $38 billion annual economic impact.

The Airside Operations Section ensures PHX's airfield operates safely, efficiently, and in full compliance with Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) regulations, including FAR Part 139. Airside Operations oversees daily aircraft movement areas, inspections, safety programs, operational coordination, NOTAM issuance, airfield construction impacts, and regulatory documentation critical to maintaining PHX's Part 139 certification and 24/7 operational readiness.

The Aviation Department is seeking an Airside Operations Program Manager to provide program level leadership across airfield regulatory programs, oversee operational coordination, and manage compliance initiatives that directly support airfield safety and efficiency. This role serves as a key leader in the Airside Operations Section, responsible for aligning airfield programs with departmental goals, supervising multiple operational units, and advancing strategic initiatives that sustain PHX's reputation as a world class airport.

Airside Operations employs field staff, supervisors, and program leaders who support PHX's constant airfield activity. The Airside Operations Program Manager will be instrumental in regulatory compliance, operational excellence, employee development, and cross divisional coordination that strengthens PHX's airfield performance.

Key Duties Include

Program & Strategic Leadership

Provide program-level direction for FAA Part 139 compliance, ensuring policies, inspections, documentation, and safety evaluations meet regulatory requirements.
Lead development of airfield programs aligned with AVN¿s strategic goals, including inspection tracking, safety initiatives, and operational performance measures.
Coordinate program updates, compliance documentation, and strategic recommendations for Section and Division leadership.

Airside Operations & Daily Coordination

Direct and support daily airfield operations to maintain safe and efficient aircraft movement consistent with FAA and airport standards.
Provide expert guidance on complex operational challenges impacting safety, customer service, and regulatory compliance.
Oversee special events, VIP aircraft movements, and irregular operations requiring cross-agency coordination.

Regulatory Compliance & Safety Programs

Manage daily implementation of FAA Part 139 requirements, including inspections, safety risk management, and corrective actions.
Participate in FAA Safety Risk Management (SRM) panels to support hazard identification and mitigation strategies.
Oversee Construction Safety and Phasing Plans (CSPPs) for all airfield construction projects.
Support daily management of the Safety Management System (SMS).

Contractor, Construction, and Project Coordination

Coordinate operational impacts of airfield construction with Engineering, Facilities, contractors, and FAA representatives.
Review and provide guidance on construction phasing, closures, and NOTAM issuance.
Support integration of airfield operational needs into project planning.

Team Development & Collaboration

Supervise Airside Operations Supervisor II positions and provide indirect oversight for Airside Operations Assistants.
Lead recruitment, performance management, and workforce development initiatives.
Coordinate cross-divisional collaboration supporting operational readiness.

Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement

Prepare and present airfield program updates, compliance reports, and operational analyses.
Maintain communication with airlines, tenants, FAA representatives, and contractors.

Knowledge of the aviation industry.
Familiar with technical writing.

Proficient decision-making skills and effective at problem-solving and compliance resolution.

Strong knowledge of FAA regulations, Safety Management System (SMS) principles, airport construction impacts, and NOTAM processes.

organization. Bij Egov Select vind je een innovatieve kijk op ICT-dienstverlening met maatschappelijke relevantie. Als autonome organisatie ondersteunen we de federale overheidsdiensten bij hun zoektocht naar gespecialiseerde en gekwalificeerde ICT-medewerkers.

Wil je in een boeiende omgeving
werken met uitdagingen die verbonden zijn aan de informatisering van diensten en daarbij ook nog een meerwaarde creëren
voor de maatschappij ? Dan is een ICT job binnen één van onze openbare diensten een job voor jou. We streven naar een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé
(bijvoorbeeld dankzij de mogelijkheid van telewerken, flexibele werkuren, gemakkelijk bereikbare gebouwen) en bieden een marktconform salaris
- inclusief een hele reeks extralegale voordelen.

Egov Select - Senior IT Project Manager

Ref. 1357

De FOD Beleid en Ondersteuning (BOSA) speelt binnen de federale administratie een sleutelrol in het uitbouwen van een moderne overheid ten dienste van burgers en ondernemingen. Opgericht op 1 maart 2017, ondersteunt de Federale Overheidsdienst (FOD) Beleid en Ondersteuning - ook wel “FOD BOSA” genoemd - de regering en de federale organisaties in diverse domeinen: IT, HR, organisatiebeheer en integriteitsbeleid, begroting, boekhouding en overheidsopdrachten.

De FOD BOSA draagt als centrale speler bij tot een moderne administratie die burgers en bedrijven optimaal bedient. Meer informatie over de FOD BOSA (missie, visie, waarden, organigram).

De DG Vereenvoudiging en Digitalisering (DG Vd) heeft als opdracht om de dienstverlening aan burgers en bedrijven te digitaliseren en te vereenvoudigen, en het ontwikkelen van digitale diensten voor de overheid en ondernemingen te ondersteunen.

Binnen de DG Vd stelt het departement “Digitale interacties met burgers en Toegankelijkheid” het platform Fast2web ter beschikking van de verschillende federale overheidsdiensten (FOD's). Deze dienst staat in voor het creëren, hosten, onderhouden en ondersteunen van meer dan 220 federale websites, waaronder het merendeel van de FOD-websites.

Functieomschrijving

Als Senior Project Manager vorm je de schakel tussen IT en Business en weet je teams te aligneren rond duidelijke doelstellingen, in een iteratieve en veranderlijke context.

Je Takenpakket Omvat Onder Meer

Coördinatie van de support- en onderhoudsteams van het F2w-platform:
Het aansturen en coördineren van de activiteiten van het supportteam en het team dat instaat voor het onderhoud.
Het organiseren en leiden van teamvergaderingen en het opvolgen van Agile-sessies (stand-ups, reviews, evaluatiemomenten).
Het opvolgen en plannen van de volgende belangrijke stappen (ontwikkelingssprints) en het waarborgen van de kwaliteit van de sprintdeliverables.
Het bewaken van prioriteiten en het oplossen van problemen.
Het organiseren van coördinatievergaderingen met andere teams en betrokken stakeholders.

Organisatie van de support- en onderhoudsteams voor Fast2web (F2w):
Opstellen van een roadmap voor de verdere ontwikkeling van het Drupal-Openfed-platform (en opvolging ervan).
Opstellen en opvolgen van projectplanningen, inclusief toewijzing van middelen.
Voorstellen van prioriteiten ter goedkeuring door het management en het maken van keuzes tussen concurrerende aanvragen en transversale thema's.
Definiëren en documenteren van operationele procedures voor het beheer van onderhouds- en supportaanvragen, met het oog op kwaliteitsverbetering van de dienstverlening.
Organiseren van wekelijkse reviews, eerst met de IT-architect en vervolgens met het BOSA-team (CAB), om activiteiten voor de komende onderhoudscycli (sprints) te bepalen en goed te keuren.
Beheren van change requests en het systematisch opvolgen van scope, timing en kwaliteit.
Escalaties uitvoeren wanneer nodig en afwijkingen beheren binnen de vastgelegde tolerantiedrempels van het project.
Voorbereiden van stuurgroepen en executive rapporten om besluitvorming te faciliteren.
Regelmatig rapporteren over voortgang en risico's aan het management, de stuurgroep en/of andere organen.
Operationeel en prestatiegericht opvolgen van het onderhoud en de support van F2w.
Toezien op het naleven van specifieke projectvoorwaarden met leveranciers en externe partners.
Toezicht houden op de uitvoering van onderhoudswerken (correctief, evolutief en adaptief) en waken over de kwaliteit van de opleveringen.
Opstellen van wekelijkse voortgangsrapporten en opvolging van sprints; optreden als beheerder en verantwoordelijke van de CAB (Change Advisory Board).
De prestaties en werkbelasting van het team opvolgen om te garanderen dat activiteiten binnen de afgesproken termijnen worden geleverd en eventuele workload- of capaciteitsproblemen tijdig signaleren.
Activiteitsgegevens analyseren (uit het Jira-tool) om wekelijkse rapporten op te maken, verbeterpunten te identificeren en corrigerende acties op te volgen.
Risico's identificeren en anticiperen, preventieve oplossingen voorstellen en toezien op hun implementatie.
Wekelijks rapporteren (vergaderingen en presentaties) aan het management over de support- en onderhoudsactiviteiten.

Profielbeschrijving

Je beschikt over een bachelor- of masterdiploma, of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
Je kan minstens 10 jaar ervaring aantonen in het beheer van complexe IT-projecten..
Je hebt een sterke affiniteit met Agile-werkmethoden (Scrum, SAFe, Kanban...) en ervaring met een iteratieve projectaanpak.
Je hebt een grondige kennis van projectmethodologieën (zoals het Agile-framework).
Je hebt een diepgaande kennis van projectmanagementtools zoals Jira (incl. scripting) of Plan.IO.
Je beschikt over sterke organisatorische en planningsvaardigheden; je behoudt het overzicht en kan prioriteiten voorstellen die door het management worden goedgekeurd.
Je communiceert duidelijk, diplomatisch en efficiënt met alle niveaus binnen een organisatie.
Je hebt een uitstekende kennis van het Frans en een goede kennis van het Nederlands en het Engels.

Wij bieden

Onze federale overheid bevindt zich midden in een digitale transformatie: van uitdagingen op het vlak van cybersecurity tot digitale communicatie, van netwerkverbeteringen om onze nieuwe manier van werken te ondersteunen tot complexe ontwikkelingsprojecten en de optimalisatie van bestaande toepassingen. Wil jij deel uitmaken van dit proces en maatschappelijke meerwaarde creëren, terwijl je werkt aan je persoonlijke ontwikkeling en je ambities waarmaakt?

Wij bieden je een contract van onbepaalde duur met een duidelijke doelstelling in een stimulerende omgeving, een zeer competitief salarispakket aangevuld met een reeks extralegale voordelen en een mobiliteitsbudget (hospitalisatieverzekering, telewerk, maaltijdcheques, mobiliteit, pensioenfonds, enz.). We hechten ook veel belang aan een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé, en onze kantoren zijn vlot bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer.

Manage project requirements and ensure teams remain aligned to business objectives throughout the project lifecycle.

Stakeholder & Team Management

Broad business knowledge, including manufacturing, supply chain, procurement, quality, and service functions, and how they contribute to successful project delivery.
Ability to work flexibly across product lines, business units, and geographical locations.

new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

About The Role

As the Senior Global Operations Manager of Fulfillment & Outbound Logistics, you will own Verkada's global 3PL network and oversee inbound, warehouse, and outbound logistics operations across multiple regions. You'll be responsible for optimizing supply chain performance, managing strategic logistics partners, driving cost savings, and ensuring world-class service levels. We're looking for an experienced operations leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys solving complex supply chain challenges, and is passionate about building scalable global logistics processes.

What You'll Do

Own and manage strategic partnerships with global 3PL providers, including vendor selection, contract negotiations, performance management, and quarterly business reviews.
Oversee inbound, warehouse, and outbound logistics operations across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve service levels across the supply chain.
Develop and monitor KPIs including freight costs, inventory performance, order accuracy, fill rates, and on-time delivery.
Manage inventory deployment strategies, distribution network optimization, and reverse logistics (RMA/refurbishment) programs.
Partner cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Planning, Operations, and external logistics providers to resolve operational issues and improve execution.
Establish and maintain supply chain SOPs while driving adoption of best practices across internal teams and 3PL partners.
Lead implementation and optimization of supply chain systems, including WMS, TMS, and ERP integrations.
Present operational performance, trends, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
Must be willing and able to work onsite five days per week.

What You Bring

8+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics, or operations management, including 5+ years managing 3PL partnerships.
Experience overseeing global logistics operations across multiple regions and international supply chains.
Strong background in warehouse, transportation, fulfillment, and distribution network management.
Experience with WMS, TMS, ERP platforms, and advanced Excel for reporting and data analysis.
Proven success driving cost reduction initiatives and improving operational efficiency through process optimization.
Experience managing vendor relationships, negotiating contracts, and holding logistics providers accountable to SLAs.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into operational improvements.
Excellent communication and project management skills with experience leading cross-functional initiatives.
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related field. APICS CSCP, Lean Six Sigma, or similar certifications are a plus.

Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans
Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage
Starting January 2027, Verkada will match a portion of an employee’s 401(k) contributions based on eligible earnings. Match vests on 2 year anniversary
Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options
Expanded mental health support
Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits
Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time
Professional development stipend
Wellness/fitness benefits
Healthy lunches provided daily
Commuter benefits

Additional Information

You must be independently authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role, at this time.

Annual Pay Range

At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. Job Description

Qualifacts is a leading provider of behavioral health software and SaaS solutions for clinical productivity, compliance and state reporting, billing, and business intelligence. Its mission is to be an innovative and trusted technology and end-to-end solutions partner, enabling exceptional outcomes for its customers and those they serve. Qualifacts’ comprehensive portfolio, including the CareLogic®, Credible™, and InSync® platforms, spans and serves the entire behavioral health, rehabilitative, and human services market supporting non-profit Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinics (CCBHC) as well as for-profit large enterprise and small business providers. Qualifacts has a loyal customer base, with more than 2,500 customers representing 75,000 providers serving more than 6 million patients. Qualifacts was recognized in the 2022 and 2023 Best in KLAS: Software and Services report as having the top ranked Behavioral Health EHR solutions.

If you want to work inside an atmosphere where innovation has purpose, and your ambition works to support our customers and those they serve, please apply today!

We are seeking candidates in Nashville or Tampa to work a hybrid schedule in either office location. Remote candidates will not be considered.

Summary Of The Project Manager

The Project Manager will be applying company policies and procedures to resolve a variety of issues. They will determine a course of action based on guidelines and modify processes and methods as required. They should have a basic knowledge of task management and project management concepts to apply this knowledge and basic problem-solving techniques to define and resolve problems. They will determine a course of action based on guidelines.

Responsibilities For The Project Manager

Manages full implementation project life cycle from kick-off preparation through implementation completion and transition to support for small to mid-range projects
Manages customer relationships and expectations through regular touchpoints, distribution of status briefings and onsite meetings
Interfaces with customer staff across levels and departments throughout project lifecycle
Influences customer attitudes, behaviors, and intentions throughout every phase of the implementation process, ensuring alignment, adoption, and long-term success
Ensures that all projects are executed properly maintaining customer satisfaction, along with attaining desired outcomes in cost, quality and delivery timeframes
Tracks project timelines updating the team with status reports in order to meet and exceed projected metrics
Works with management to determine resource management, project plans, and risk assessment in order to keep the customers on target
Works closely with cross-functional teams to resolve project issues in order to optimize results while minimizing project costs
Partners with diverse departments such as Sales, Product, Sate reporting, and RCMS to drive alignment, streamline workflows, and achieve shared project goals
Builds productive internal/external working relationships to resolve mutual problems by collaborating on procedures or transactions
Focuses on providing standard professional advice and creates initial reports/analyzes for review by experienced team professionals
Focuses on providing standard project guidance based on platform implementation methodologies and creates initial reports/analyzes for review by management

Qualifications Of The Project Manager

Bachelor’s degree (additional equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of degree)
5 years’ experience in project management or a related role; behavioral health experience preferred
PMP preferred

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Of The Project Manager

Ability to manage multiple customer projects working with differing timelines
Strong communication skills, both written and spoken
Expertise in organization and multitasking
Able to juggle multiple projects at once with little to no direction
Use a consultative approach with clients and adapt communication style to the audience
Ability to travel 25% of the time

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. About The Role

Peraton is seeking a Cyber Threat Analyst in our Linthicum, MD office in support of our Department of Defense (DoD) customer as part of a highly talented, highly motivated, and high-performing team. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of cyber investigations, digital forensics, cyber threat analysis, and mission support in a dynamic and collaborative environment. The successful candidate will contribute to protecting national security interests by leveraging technical expertise, analytical skills, and innovative problem-solving to address complex cyber challenges. Individuals who are passionate about cybersecurity, committed to excellence, and eager to make a meaningful impact are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities:

Cyber Threat Analysis: Analyze and interpret cyber threat intelligence with a focus on threats impacting the Defense Industrial Base (DIB). Identify potential risks and vulnerabilities affecting defense contractors and their supply chains.
Reporting: Prepare detailed reports and briefings on cyber incidents, threat analysis, and investigative findings with particular emphasis on impacts to the DIB. Communicate findings and recommendations to senior officials and stakeholders.
Incident Response: Triage, analysis and support incident response activities related to cybersecurity incidents affecting the DIB, including detection, analysis, and mitigation of breaches or attacks.
Collaboration: Work closely with DIB and interagency partners to share information and coordinate response efforts. Facilitate communication and support to defense contractors as needed.
Tool Utilization: Use cybersecurity tools and technologies to conduct fusion analysis; performs queries, pivots on indicators, and research malware characteristics (Message-Digest Algorithm 5 (MD5), Secure Hash Algorithm 1 (SHA1), file size, file name, file paths, etc.). May leverage tools such as Analyst1, Kibana, Virus Total, Recorded Future, etc.
Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the development and enhancement of cyber investigation methodologies, tools, and processes, with a particular focus on improving security within the DIB.

Qualifications

Clearance requirement: Active/current Secret (TS/SCI preferred).
Education: Associates degree and 7+ years of experience; OR Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of experience; OR Master's Degree and 3+ years of experience. Or 0 years with PhD. However, four (4) years of additional relevant experience or specialized training will be considered in lieu of a Bachelor's degree. Relevant certifications (e.g., CYSA+, CISSP, CEH, CISM) are preferred.
Experience: Experience in cybersecurity analysis, incident response, or digital forensics. Requires a detailed knowledge of Department of Defense and service level (Army, Navy, Air Force) intelligence communities, including collection methods, production resources, and responsibilities. Knowledge of advanced persistent threats (APTs), Tactics Techniques and Procedures (TTPs)
Technical Skills: Proficiency in cybersecurity tools and technologies (e.g., Virus Total, Domain Tools, SIEM, IDS/IPS, forensic analysis tools). Knowledge of operating systems, network protocols, cyber threat actors, cyber kill chain, Indicator of Compromises (IOCs) and MITRE ATT&CK framework
Analytical Skills: Requires skills and abilities in supervising the handling classified information. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and provide actionable insights.
Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information and threat impacts to non-technical audiences and stakeholders. Requires prior experience briefing information to decision-makers and leaders. Uses Jira to track analysis tasks and communicate status.
Team Player: Ability to work effectively in a team environment and collaborate with various stakeholders, including those in the DIB. Provides mentorship to less-senior analysts.

Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.
